Ye Li was not accustomed to being so close to him, and at this moment his loud voice was still blabbering and directly repeating Rufeng's words.

It only made her face flush and burn with embarrassment...

Ye Li turned her head and covered Mo Chen's mouth!

Mo Chen had lost his wits and had no awareness of boundaries between men and women.

At this moment, those soft hands pressed against his lips, their delicate and tender textures touching, stirring his heart.

He took Ye Li's hand down. Mo Chen felt his heart pounding wildly. He looked at it, then kissed it, and laughed cheerfully like a child who had gotten candy:

"Pear Wife's hands are not only white, but also fragrant. When you get close to me, my heart beats so fast. Do you want to feel it?"

With that, he took her hand again and pressed it toward the direction of his heart.

Caught off guard, Ye Li was flirted with once more by the General's straightforwardness!

The sound of "thump, thump, thump" coming from beneath her hand...

Beating powerfully, one beat after another, transmitting through body heat, making it impossible for anyone to ignore.

That heart was beating rapidly just for her...

chapters.title: The General's Manor Revitalized
chapters.content:
Mo Chen had Ye Li feel his heartbeat.

Ye Li was shocked by his action...

The young man's sincere gaze and the scorching body temperature carrying the pulse of his heart made her momentarily at a loss.

She could only stare at him blankly.

Returning to the General's Manor, Mo Chen visibly relaxed the moment he was in his own home.

Noticing that Ye Li had stains on her from the fire earlier, he even took the initiative to lead her to wash her hands.

Over an antique bronze basin, he took her hand.

Their hands intertwined, slowly rubbing against each other in the clean water.

For some reason, she had expected ordinary cleaning, but this sudden physical contact...

Abruptly made Ye Li somewhat uncomfortable.

Ye Li belatedly realized that this was the first time she had ever held hands with a boy!

Their fingers were entangled, and his heat transferred to her hand.

In an instant, she felt so hot.

Why is the weather so hot?

Why is this water so hot?

Mo Chen, whose mind was not fully developed, had no concept of keeping a proper distance between men and women.

At this moment, following his habit, after washing his hands, he generously wiped her hand against his own clothes.

Watching her hand being grabbed by Mo Chen and rubbed back and forth against his chest, she shrank her hand into a fist in fright.

Mo Chen raised her small clenched fist, blew on it, and said earnestly:

"It'll be clean soon. Let me blow on it, and it'll be better in a moment."

A tingling, ticklish sensation came from the back of her hand and her palm. Ye Li watched his actions with a blushing face and a racing heart.

She wanted to refuse.

However, her wrist was firmly held, unable to be pulled back.

She only felt her face grow even hotter.

It wasn't until the water droplets on Ye Li's hands were completely dried off on his clothes that he finally stopped.

Mo Chen looked at her with shining eyes, much like some kind of animal.

If someone were to hold up a mirror for him right now, they would probably see his eyes looking like a little puppy waiting for its master's praise.

Ye Li thought to herself that her eyes must be playing tricks on her.

Some loyal dog? This was a general who had killed his way out of the battlefield!

Having washed away the dirt from the fire, Mo Chen began to hold her hand and take her on a tour of his domain.

Along the way, he exclaimed with admiration, "Wife, your hands are so smooth!"

Child! Men and women should not touch hands when giving or receiving things!

Unable to hear Ye Li's inner thoughts, Mo Chen showered her with compliments.

This left Ye Li feeling both awkward and embarrassed, and his hand never stopped holding hers.

If one were to look closely at Ye Li right now, they would see her face flushed as red as the evening glow.

She was unaccustomed to such intimate physical contact.

Yet, being treated this way by Mo Chen, whose intelligence was only that of a seven or eight-year-old, his gaze was clear and bright, devoid of romantic affection, filled only with adoration and admiration.

Facing someone like this, Ye Li could not bear to refuse, and could only silently endure his overstepping.

She thought to herself: He saved you, and now your savior is out of his mind, don't think too much into it...

Returning home and looking at the courtyard full of red flowers and green leaves, Mo Chen said with disappointment:

"None of these flowers and plants are as pretty as my wife. From now on, just looking at you will be enough for me."

Listening to Mo Chen's sweet romantic words being tossed out as if they cost nothing.

Taking a deep breath, Ye Li sighed:

Invisibility in charming others is the most fatal of all!

She raised her hand and wrote in water on the wooden table:

"Hungry? Want to eat?"

Mo Chen smiled, took the opportunity to grab her other hand, pressed them palm-to-palm, and said with a satisfied look:

"Ever since I met my wife and had someone to accompany me, I haven't been hungry anymore. It's so good to have you!"

With that handsome face of his, expressing his fondness so straightforwardly.

Ye Li felt that the blush on her face never faded...

Please, stop talking!

A textbook example of talking while eating and sleeping!

Saying all these heart-fluttering things!

Ye Li silently reminded herself: Children say whatever comes to mind, children say whatever comes to mind...

Don't take it seriously.

The two walked to the kitchen of the General's Manor.

It was obvious that the food at the General's Manor was a bit simpler than that of the imperial-bestowed residence, lacking any expensive ingredients.

However, Ye Li had lived alone for a long time, so cooking was not difficult for her at all.

To shut the general up from spouting endless sweet Nothings after losing his sanity, she deliberately prepared a wide variety of delicious dishes.

She also whipped up an ancient version of milk tea.

What Ye Li had previously said about "selling milk tea to support you" was actually not a joke.

The master of the General's Manor was deeply embroiled in an assassination crisis, and she, having transmigrated here, wanted to earn a bit more money, with leverage, she could live better and exchange resources.

According to the original owner's memories, this era had completely no concept of developed cuisine.

Seasonings were rarely used in cooking, leaving dishes clear and watery.

The Tianshu Kingdom favored a plump body type.

The fatter one was, the more blessed they were considered.

Men could be promoted faster in official positions.

If women were plump and chubby, they were considered to have good fortune.

Even matchmakers wore out their doorsteps, creating a truly flourishing scene where a single daughter in a family had a hundred suitors.

As a result, many people only focused on eating meat voraciously; as long as it was edible, they didn't want to waste time and effort researching delicacies.

Mo Chen was a rare muscular type. Having served in the military where grain and provisions were often withheld by the imperial court, he was not fat.

However, that didn't mean he didn't like good food.

When Ye Li placed the milk tea in front of him, he still held a hint of doubt, but after taking a sip, he loved it endlessly!

He drank two whole bowls.

Seeing that it was a success, Ye Li invited Rufeng to try some as well.

After all, the ingredients had not been purified like in modern times, so the taste was slightly different.

However, after taking a sip, Rufeng greatly appreciated it, which finally set Ye Li's mind at ease.

She concentrated on studying the proportions of various gourmet recipes.

In the capital, because the imperial-bestowed residence had been burned down, commoners and the imperial court alike were in an uproar.

This, however, gave the General's Manor a breathing spell.

By the time Ye Li let loose in the General's Manor and hosted a lavish feast resembling a Manchu-Han banquet,

Rufeng and a group of household generals were already utterly won over in admiration...

The out-of-mind General had transformed into Ye Li's number one fan.

He demanded a cup of "Gentleman's Tea" every single day.

"Gentleman's Tea" was the name Ye Li gave to this ancient version of milk tea.

One of the bestselling items checked-in by modern internet celebrities was milk tea placed inside a bamboo tube, small cups that drove everyone to vie in pursuit.

People of this era also fancied themselves refined, pursuing the sentiment of "one cannot live without bamboo."

Inside the bamboo tube, Ye Li added a couple of bamboo leaves.

Drawing from the line in "Bamboo Stone", "Thousand blows and ten thousand strikes yet it remains strong and tenacious, letting the winds blow from east, west, north, or south," she highlighted the noble character of bamboo, while also adding a marketing gimmick to the product.

On the very first day it was put on sale, it sold out completely, with people still begging to buy more.

Ye Li tried a small batch and found it viable.

Thus, she discussed with Rufeng to start with milk tea, gradually expanding to desserts and cuisine, and finally opening a tavern.

She needed time to figure out the tastes of this era while keeping a low profile.

The General's Manor was currently a tall tree catching the wind; if she suddenly produced things that were too advanced, she was afraid she would be targeted.

It was better to let everyone assume that a mute bride married into the General's Manor simply wanted to make a modest living through small business.

Ye Li still remembered that even when Mo Chen was injured, he had entrusted her with the fact that the General's Manor supported many soldiers disabled on the battlefield, hoping she wouldn't cut off the supply of daily necessities.

Therefore, after Mo Chen brought her back to the General's Manor, she racked her brains to recall how she used to draw industrial design blueprints in her past life.

She successively drew structural blueprints for wheelchairs, single-wheel pushcarts, and underarm double crutches.

These items were all quite practical for disabled individuals.

Because she could not speak, she had to carefully list the proportions for every measurement, during which she frequently visited the disabled soldiers in the General's Manor.

Seeing that the madam did not disdain them, but instead handled everything personally and actively integrated into the military atmosphere, Rufeng was overjoyed and held even greater respect for Ye Li.

Seeing his wife willing to accompany him to the wounded soldiers' ward, Mo Chen was also extremely happy.

Everyone assumed that the madam only wanted to help out by making tables and chairs.

Ye Li had already successfully assembled a wheelchair with the help of the craftsmen!

When she personally demonstrated it to everyone in the courtyard, all the wounded soldiers seemed to see hope; this contraption could actually allow people with leg injuries to walk as smoothly as on flat ground...

And those underarm crutches were also extremely practical!

Using the wheelchair on flat ground and crutches for stairs, all the brothers would be able to go out in the future instead of staying in the wounded soldiers' ward like useless parasites gnawing on rice!

In an instant, the entire General's Manor was in a boil!

If not for the conventions between men and women, many of the wounded would have wanted to lift the madam up.

Even the wounded soldiers lying in bed like living corpses insisted on kneeling to pay respects to the madam.

For a time, Ye Li's kind deed won the praise of everyone.

Mo Chen was also very happy, and he expressed his emotions more directly.

He rushed over and picked up Ye Li. Holding her slender waist, the memory-loss Mo Chen spun around directly in the courtyard.

A crowd of soldiers clapped and jeered from the sidelines.

It made Ye Li's face turn impossibly red...

Big brother! You are a general, a general! Can you maintain some dignity in front of your subordinates?

Don't I have any pride?

In the courtyard, everyone's emotions were extremely excited as they admired the general lifting his wife and spinning around affectionately.

Leaves drifted down with the wind, fluttering as if celebrating the intimacy of the youth and maiden...

Holding her, Mo Chen smiled brightly, the sunlight spilling across the young man's face, dazzling and eye-catching:

"Wife, can I kiss you?"

chapters.title: A Glance Lasts a Lifetime, Only for You
chapters.content:
"Wife, may I kiss you?"

The young general's eyes were bright, shining brilliantly in the sunlight.

Ye Li was held in his arms, surrounded by a clamoring, bustling crowd.

Clearly, the crowds were surging, everyone gathered around them, cheering loudly.

Yet she could only see his face.

From this downward angle, she could even see his long eyelashes, looking like golden fans in the sunlight.

Fluttering with every beat, full of trust and joy, they stirred the doors of her heart as well.

Blushing, Ye Li hurriedly shook her head, begging him not to say such heart-throbbing things so bluntly!

Seeing her shake her head, Mo Chen was not discouraged. Instead, he said:

"Wife, then teach me how to paint!"

Against her better judgment, Ye Li nodded.

Seeing her agree, Mo Chen smiled even more happily and picked her up to spin around again.

Rufeng, having witnessed the miraculous utility of the wheelchair, was already discussing with several brothers how to flatten the steps of the General's Mansion so that the wheelchair could move around completely unhindered.

For a moment, everyone in the General's Mansion was filled with drive.

Everything was discussed, and everyone had hope.

They were grateful to the General's Wife, and they were grateful to the General.

It was the General who had taken them in, and it was the Wife who gave them new hope.

Mo Chen held her all the way back to the main courtyard of the General's Mansion.

He was exceptionally, extraordinarily happy today, holding Ye Li tightly in his arms all the way without letting go. Originally, Ye Li had been extremely nervous being carried by him in public.

Now that they were back in the main courtyard with just the two of them, she finally relaxed.

She wanted him to put her down, but as soon as Mo Chen set her down, he wrapped her in his arms once more.

His scorching body heat enveloped her again, carrying intense passion. Ye Li caught the crisp, pleasant scent on Mo Chen.

A Mo Chen who had lost his sanity wore his emotions on his sleeve, unlike his usual steady self.

He did almost whatever came to his mind.

At this moment, he was overwhelmingly happy, only lamenting that he had only two hands; otherwise, he would have liked to hold his cute wife even more.

Ye Li heard a low, magnetic masculine voice transmit by her ear:

"Wife, do you know how happy I am?"

"Every time, I feel like I'm so useless. Ever since I woke up, nobody likes me; they only like the grown-up me..."

"I can't do anything, I can't accomplish anything..."

"Everyone just hoped I would disappear, and later on, I did disappear. But this time I actually woke up again..."

"I don't know why I woke up, someone like me who can't do anything at all..."

Mo Chen's voice was full of guilt, carrying a profundity inconsistent with his usual child-like behavior, and brimming with pain.

Ye Li shook her head, and used lip-reading to say:

"You are wonderful, truly wonderful."

The kindness and gentleness of his youth had extended to the General Lord she met.

Wasn't it precisely this pure and innocent heart that had saved her, a commoner, back then?

Mo Chen looked at her, his eyes as brilliant as the stars, and said with a smile:

"But Wife can do it. Wife helped the older brothers walk out of the wounded soldiers' courtyard. They are very happy, and I am very happy..."

Mo Chen pressed his forehead against Ye Li's, murmuring:

"It's really wonderful..."

"So wonderful..."

Tears welled up in Mo Chen's eyes. She watched him shed tears.

A sadness ached in the bottom of her heart.

Clearly a bright and sunny day, yet Ye Li seemed to see him surrounded by dark clouds, gloomy and depressed.

Having just arrived in this world, she did not know Mo Chen's past, nor the origin of the "Forget Sorrow" poison.

Even less did she know why the high-spirited young general harbored a death wish in his heart, feeling he shouldn't be alive...

A long, long time later.

When she learned the whole truth...

Understanding why Mo Chen was poisoned and injured time and time again, understanding his plotting, his pain, his loneliness and despair...

She realized that even if the gods listened to the mortal fireworks and prayers, there were still people in this world whom the gods did not bless year after year.

And she herself, piercing through the arrows of the mortal world, entangled with the fate of the youth, perhaps came solely to save him.

As a wisp of a lonely soul, she had also long broken out of her cocoon and transformed into a butterfly amidst the shared storms, morphing into the self of her dreams.

The fate of the mortal world is deep or shallow; it is both redemption and growth.

Only by breaking can there be establishment; the phoenix nirvana has its destined course.

These things are set aside for now.

At this moment, watching the youth shed tears, she could only hold him gently, patting him stroke by stroke, silently offering comfort.

A youth's emotions always come quickly and go just as fast.

In a short while, Mo Chen had calmed down.

Then, he acted like a sweet spoiled child and said:

"Wife, I want to learn to paint."

Ye Li brought him to the table, where the children's picture book stories drawn earlier were still laid out. Mo Chen gathered them page by page and arranged them neatly.

Then Ye Li used clear water on the table to ask: "I am not speaking out loud, can you understand my lip-reading?"

Mo Chen said: "I can, I can!"

Then Ye Li directly used lip-reading to say:

"Mo Chen? Can you hear me? Learning to paint is very hard, you know."

Mo Chen's smile was beaming: "Mm-hmm, with Wife speaking, no matter what is said, I will understand."

"Wife can call me A-Chen; I am not afraid of hardship."

Ye Li had accidentally overheard this from the soldiers in the wounded soldiers' courtyard earlier.

Mo Chen and most of the soldiers responsible for reconnaissance could read lips, because only thus could they survey the enemy's situation more smoothly.

If they were to paint, verbal guidance was indispensable; writing words alone simply wouldn't do.

That being the case, there was no problem.

She sat down and began to grind the ink.

Learning to paint usually required practicing lines first, and Ye Li intended to let him practice his linework.

Who would have known that Mo Chen would say:

"I want to paint Wife, please teach me how!"

Ye Li was so startled that her hand shook, and a drop of ink fell from the brush, blooming on the paper...

Are you kidding me?

Drawing a portrait right off the bat?

Young man, aren't you getting a bit too full of yourself?

And the subject is drawing herself...

She feared she might harvest several "Yuhua" faces every day. Ye Li shook her head fiercely.

She said seriously: "No."

An orthodox illustrator from an art academy insisted on starting with the basics.

Just as well, Mo Chen's mental age was currently under ten, so building a foundation was still feasible.

Ye Li took out a few sheets of paper, drew simple shapes on them respectively, and intended to let Mo Chen practice his hand-feel on the first day.

To her surprise, a serious Mo Chen was indeed quite remarkable.

He sat with a very proper attitude, waist and back straight, expression focused. He looked intently, every stroke he made was steady, and within the time it took to burn an incense stick, the assignment Ye Li had given him was finished.

Ye Li raised an eyebrow. This linework was quite good.

As expected of ancients accustomed to using writing brushes; their hands were indeed very steady.

Seeing that he was still eager for more, on top of single shapes, Ye Li drew combinations, where the images possessed front-and-back overlapping relationships and richer layers.

Mo Chen took it and meticulously copied it.

Ye Li was at the side; having nothing better to do, she also continued to paint.

However, what she was drawing was the layout plan of the General's Mansion.

Now that the mobility of the wounded soldiers in the wounded courtyard was no longer a major issue, she could try remodeling the scenery of the General's Mansion.

After all, though her status as "General's Wife" was fake, she had genuinely obtained all of Mo Chen's savings.

Yet the young man had handed over his wealth and power, leaving the General's Mansion to her management.

Since he entrusted her with trust, she would give him a unique General's Mansion!

There were already courtyards in the General's Mansion housing wounded soldiers, but Ye Li renamed it "Green Bamboo Courtyard," sharing the same meaning as Bamboo Milk Tea.

The name "Wounded Soldiers' Courtyard" easily caused people to wallow in the past, so Ye Li changed it.

The General's Mansion had always been low-key, steady, and dark in color. Ye Li changed it.

She arranged dry-landscape Chinese gardens for their residences, white sand spread on the ground, surrounded by bamboo leaves, and dug water channels to create the exquisite winding-water party scenery, installing water wheels in the ponds to increase vitality.

From the remodeling of the residences, green plants were added everywhere, making people feel that life had hope.

The arable land on the back mountain adopted the rice-fish co-culture method, with fish ponds underneath the trees planted in the mountains, forming an ecological cycle.

When this planning map was finished, she handed it to Rufeng, who admired her to the point of complete prostration!

The Wife didn't show off her skills, yet she was truly a master!

Through a vigorous remodeling, the entire General's Mansion lost its past desolation and gloom.

Not only was it verdant and full of vitality, but even all the disabled soldiers were filled with energy.

Joyful laughter could often be heard in the courtyards.

All of these were changes that occurred after the new wife arrived.

The crowd of Mo's soldiers now all supported Ye Li; as long as an order was issued by the Wife, someone would immediately rush to do it.

Ye Li didn't feel much about it; after all, she was in charge of the General's Mansion and all of Mo Chen's money.

Mo Chen was still seriously injured and sick, and since such a large estate fell under her management, it was natural for her to devise strategies.

Yet she had been quite troubled lately...

Because in order to paint portraits, Mo Chen had been studying hard by lamplight late into the night doing his assignments recently, and his progress had skyrocketed!

Nowadays, even his full-factor sketches were looking quite decent!

Chinese painting schools emphasize scattered-point perspective, but what Ye Li taught was the much harder angular perspective and three-point perspective.

Mo Chen's assignments were all very well-drawn, and moreover, due to his science-and-engineering-guy traits, he was agonizingly fastidious about shapes to an infuriating degree...

Looking at this perspective assignment, it was Mo Chen's new design draft for the General's Mansion.

Ye Li had asked him to progress from sketching to semi-original work, and the assignment before her had sharp foregrounds and blurry backgrounds, large near objects and small distant ones, with proportions properly handled...

It was good enough to take a graduate entrance exam...

Was this the kind of man who could carve a bloody path to become a general?

Isn't this too heaven-defying?!

Having finished submitting his assignment, Mo Chen looked at Ye Li's slightly gloomy expression and asked cautiously:

"Wife, did I draw badly?"

Ye Li shook her head. It was drawn far too well...

Seeing this, Mo Chen breathed a sigh of relief, looking at her with puppy-like eyes:

"It's all thanks to Wife's good teaching! I love Wife the most!"

Ye Li: Don't...

Mo Chen: "I want to paint Wife, and then hide you away..."

"So that you will forever belong to me alone..."

chapters.title: The Unspoken Kiss
chapters.content:
Early morning.

The General's Mansion.

Ever since the Madam's arrival, the General's Mansion had become exceptionally lively.

These days, everyone in the mansion was all smiles, very eagerly strolling around everywhere. Even the injured and wounded soldiers were no exception, either cruising around in wheelchairs or leaning on crutches. The reason was simple:

As long as one could run into the General, he would draw a dynamic sketch of you on the spot, and you could even strike your own pose.

This was Lord General's calligraphy and painting!

A portrait, at that.

In ancient times, communication and transportation were inconvenient, and longing for family members was often intense, usually maintained only through letters. If one had a portrait of oneself to send to family back home, it could bring them a shred of comfort.

What's more, most soldiers who went to war might never return once they stepped onto the battlefield...

Therefore, this portrait was proof that one had existed!

Even if it was just a sketch.

Yet, many soldiers were already thoroughly satisfied.

Knowing that Lord General still had quite a talent for learning, Ye Li taught him according to the most traditional process.

When painting people, paint the bones first, followed by the muscle distribution.

Beyond these, however, were body proportions and the mastery of movement.

Therefore, sipping her homemade bamboo tube milk tea leisurely, she watched Mo Chen draw sketches in the courtyard.

One had to admit, the poses struck by soldiers were quite bold and unrestrained, executed with sweeping grandeur.

At first, the soldiers were relatively shy, so they mostly just stood or sat.

Ye Li had drawn such poses before, so she wasn't very interested.

After demonstrating a few sample drawings for Mo Chen,

she sat to the side, writing her business plan.

Bubble tea was selling well nowadays, but one could never have too much money, so she kept writing.

By past noon,

she came to check Lord General's homework and was directly dumbfounded!

Holy crap!

She asked him to draw sketches.

She didn't ask him to draw martial arts heroes!

As it turned out, after drawing static poses for a while, Mo Chen felt it was rather strange to watch his elder brothers standing so obediently.

It wasn't until some soldiers mentioned that the vanguard possessed a fine set of spear techniques, and that his mother had fallen ill and hadn't been able to see her son for a long time...

wouldn't it be wonderful if the General could draw his posture while wielding the spear, so as to relieve the elderly mother's yearning?

Thus, communication among men was that simple and direct.

Mo Chen began drawing exaggerated movements.

The soldiers also put their all into striking various martial arts poses.

By the time Ye Li came to check the homework, the usual postures of standing, sitting, and squatting had escalated to wielding broadswords and spears, and even drawing leaps of qinggong!

The figures' movements were ethereal and free-and-easy, and although the lines weren't very fluid...

the overall physique had indeed captured the essence.

On this day, the soldiers played with martial arts to their heart's content and expressed their gratitude to Mo Chen one after another.

As for Mo Chen, he secretly wept tears of joy...

Ever since losing his memory, his heart had actually been filled with confusion and insecurity. He knew that everyone disliked his current self, only hoping he would quickly recover from the poison and return to being the formidable hero capable of handling the affairs of the entire General's Mansion.

The last time he woke up, no one accompanied him like this.

Nor did anyone show reluctance to see him when he was about to fade away.

Yet waking up this time was different.

He had a wife.

His wife treated him differently.

She could see him, she would care for him, she would cook for him, not because he was the General.

She knew he was useless, but she never looked down on him. His wife silently shouldered the daily operations of the General's Mansion and even improved the lives of his brothers.

She never complained about these things.

Now she was teaching him how to draw, and she had even helped him win the affection of the soldiers.

Presently, not only were all the injured brother-soldiers happy,

they actually smiled at him too!

One had to remember that the last time he woke up, everyone wore a troubled expression upon seeing him:

The General has lost his wits, we must find the antidote quickly...

It was all because of his wife that he had now become useful...

Mo Chen looked at Ye Li with a heart full of joy.

Just then, sunlight fell from behind Ye Li in a backlit glow, casting a layer of golden rim-light around her entire figure, making her look holy and divine.

Ye Li was in the middle of checking the homework, but she froze...

Although the sketches were drawn rather greenly, what were these movements? They were source material for martial arts films!

Ye Li hurriedly recalled the martial arts movies she had watched.

Entertainment wasn't abundant in this era. If she organized these, wouldn't they become martial arts manhua (comic books)?

Even if a single copy sold for only one copper coin, manhua could be serialized, and they could also build up her reputation!

With inspiration suddenly flashing in her mind, Ye Li said to Mo Chen, "Not bad, thumbs up for you!"

Then she bustled off in a flurry!

Right, sell martial arts comics!

She would write the script first. Mo Chen was currently at a low point; she needed to build up some momentum for him!

And what was better than cultural output?

No sooner said than done, Ye Li spent a few days conceptualizing the script and another few days compiling the sketches Mo Chen had been drawing into volumes.

Then, she sold them alongside her small bubble tea business.

She had originally wanted to sell them at bookstores or large publishing houses.

But... she had neither resources nor connections!

Ye Li was also troubled. Mo Chen couldn't show his face personally, and she couldn't speak either; there wasn't a single person in the entire General's Mansion who could act as a representative.

So she simply sold them together with her little bubble tea stall!

As it turned out, the response to this was even more sensational than the bubble tea itself!

Bubble tea was a novelty after all; some people bought it just for fun, and once the fun passed, that was it.

The repeat customer rate wasn't high.

But as soon as this martial arts manhua came out, it truly caused a sensation across the entire city!

Due to limited quantities, people passed them around, one handing it to the next.

Whenever anyone got their hands on one, they treated it like a prized possession, wishing they could engrave it into their eyes.

Furthermore, there were some young children who had dreamed of becoming great heroes since childhood.

They would sneak a glance next to the adults and start practicing the moves themselves, trying to learn martial arts from this manhua.

This matter also caught the attention of the adults!

That's right, one could learn martial arts from it!!!

For a time, this manhua casually named Wuxia Jianghu (The Martial Arts World) by Ye Li became the hottest commodity in the entire capital!

After all, if ordinary people wanted to learn martial arts, they had to kowtow to enter a sect, pay tuition fees, and giving gifts was standard procedure.

Yet what they feared most was that a grandmaster would be too proud and refuse to take on disciples!

Without a master, there was no threshold for entry.

As for martial arts manuals?

They were all hidden in secret rooms and inner chambers by various sects and noble estates, protected by layers of guards and mechanisms!

How could ordinary people ever get to see them?

Just like that, Ye Li refined the lines of the character movements drawn by Mo Chen, sprinkled various martial arts stories around these character poses, and produced a crude martial arts manhua.

Although it didn't look exquisite through a modern lens,

people in every era needed spiritual nourishment.

Ancient entertainment mostly consisted of storybooks or storytelling at teahouses.

There was deep knowledge in those too; if the stories were about romance, they would be criticized as frivolous and dissolute, failing to attend to proper duties.

Yet the theme of wuxia naturally made one's blood boil and was inherently filled with fantasy, who didn't harbor a hero's dream in their heart?

What was more, this was illustrated with both pictures and text?!

And it sold for only ten copper coins!

Ordinary families could afford it as well; it was no longer something exclusive to nobles and powerful dignitaries.

Consequently, for a time, the sales of the martial arts manhua skyrocketed, selling out every single day!

Ye Li set the price low precisely to capture the vast market of the common people. Once this book became a daily reading material akin to a magazine or newspaper that everyone scrambled for, why worry about not being able to place advertisements on it?

Since hand-drawing took a long time, Ye Li also had the wounded soldiers participate in the project.

She proclaimed that they could take home whatever money was earned and send it to their families.

In an instant, the General's Mansion was in an uproar once again, not only could they walk again after being disabled, but they could also make money!

Thus, as dawn broke every morning, wounded soldiers could be seen holding two sheets of paper, tracing against the sky.

Yes, because the quantity was too large, Ye Li didn't plan to redraw everything each time.

She simply had the soldiers place the original manuscript underneath, put a blank sheet of white paper on top, and trace the lines against the light of the sky, even people who couldn't draw could do it, as long as they had hands.

She often did this to rush through homework in her past life, except modern times had glass, making it more convenient to tape papers to a windowpane.

A busy day passed.

Ye Li and Mo Chen returned to the master bedroom and collapsed headfirst onto the bed.

Looking at his wife's exhausted expression, Mo Chen stepped forward and said softly,

"Wife, did I cause trouble for you?"

Looking at him, unable to understand the train of thought of this oversized child, Ye Li used lip-reading to convey:

"No, we are doing something very meaningful."

"We can help the people in Qingzhu Courtyard, we can make money, and in the future, we can help build a good reputation for you."

"You're amazing too, you know. Look, now so many people love the drawings you make..."

As soon as Ye Li finished speaking, she felt Mo Chen pull her into a tight embrace.

The youth's emotional voice came from beside her ear:

"I know none of them like me; what they like is..."

"Only Wife. I only have Wife."

"I only have you..."

With patient forbearance, Ye Li pacified him.

Patting his back, stroke by stroke...

While comforting Mo Chen, Ye Li began to yawn.

Gradually, her eyes closed due to drowsiness...

Night had fallen.

All was silent.

The master bedroom remained quiet for a long time.

Only a silent, quiet kiss fell gently upon Ye Li's forehead.

To love someone is to be greedy.

What I want is far more than just an embrace.

chapters.title: The General with Eight-Pack Abs
chapters.content:
Ye Li had a sound sleep.

When she opened her eyes, she still felt a bit unsatisfied.

She rubbed her eyes, rolled over, and wanted to stay in bed a little longer.

Instead, her hand brushed against something hard in the bed, startling her sleepiness away. She opened her eyes to find Mo Chen looking at her with a beaming smile.

"Wife, you're awake?"

Ye Li nodded.

In the past, after she coaxed Mo Chen to sleep, she would go to sleep on the nearby couch. She never expected that she was too tired yesterday and fell asleep right here!

She looked down and was relieved to find that they were both fully dressed.

Putting her mind at ease, Ye Li smiled back at him and said,

"Good morning!"

Mo Chen currently had the intelligence of a seven or eight-year-old child, sometimes even having to ask Rufeng about basic common sense.

He understood this era even less than she did as a time-traveler, so Ye Li didn't mind too much.

Now that she bore the title of "General's Wife," it wouldn't look right if she and Mo Chen continued to sleep in separate beds for long.

Besides, Mo Chen was innocent and pure right now, so sharing a bed was harmless.

She said to him in lip-sync: "I'll make you breakfast. What do you want to eat?"

Mo Chen smiled and said,

"Can I eat anything?"

Ye Li nodded. There were so many breakfasts from future generations; just the dim sum from Guangzhou morning tea could be made with different variations for a whole month!

Mo Chen suddenly leaned in close to her. The two of them were already lying close together, and now they were practically pressing against each other.

The young man's just-awakened voice still carried a thick, husky tone: "I want to eat..."

Ye Li wasn't used to being so intimate with a man. She pulled back slightly, terrified that if such a handsome face lunged at her first thing in the morning, she might get a nosebleed...

Seeing this, Mo Chen paused. Then, his gaze darkened, and he said with disappointment,

"Whatever wife makes, I like it."

Having received his reply, Ye Li got out of bed briskly and even helped Mo Chen wash up.

The General's Manor itself didn't have many people, and apart from Rufeng, Mo Chen didn't have any other pageboys or attendants.

Therefore, Ye Li also shouldered the duties of a little nanny.

She took his hand and led him to the kitchen, deciding to make Cantonese dim sum today!

Small, cute pork and shrimp siu mai.

Crystal-clear shrimp dumplings.

Filling turnip cakes.

Ye Li made a whole pot of pan-fried buns, stuffed with mushrooms, minced meat, and garlic seasoning.

The bottoms of the buns were purposely pan-fried over high heat in an iron skillet.

They were fried to a golden brown, with a crispy texture. Just thinking of the pan-fried buns from her past life made her mouth water!

In Guangdong, breakfasts every day consisted of a rich variety of dim sum, and morning tea time could stretch all the way from morning to night.

This used to be the ceiling of breakfast in Ye Li's mind.

Coming to ancient times, with natural ingredients, plenty of time, and no shortage of silver notes,

she naturally had to treat herself well and experiment with food by ringing the changes.

Remembering that Mo Chen actually couldn't eat anything too greasy, and still needed liquid and lighter foods,

Ye Li also made millet congee for breakfast today.

Watching his wife's busy figure in the kitchen, Mo Chen felt for a moment that it all seemed unreal.

When the delicious breakfast was finally served on the table, he was completely and utterly conquered.

The yellowish siu mai, made with wheat flour and eggs into a thin wrapper, was stuffed to the brim with meat filling and shrimp.

The golden outer skin, topped with a large shrimp, made for an enticing appearance.

With a single bite, it was packed with meat, springy to the teeth, fresh, and juicy.

He had never eaten anything so delicious in his life!

Ye Li then picked up a shrimp dumpling and placed it on his plate.

The skin of the shrimp dumpling was crystal-clear like jade, through which the shrimp inside could be faintly seen. Mo Chen took a bite, and it was truly, wonderfully delicious!

After a satisfying breakfast, they went for a leisurely stroll.

In the early morning, the fresh scent of earth mingled with the fragrance of flowers, and every step was filled with crisp air.

Ancient life was truly refreshing. Ye Li gradually adapted to the life in the General's Manor, finding it much more comfortable than that imperial-bestowed residence.

Ye Li picked a few more flowers by the corridor and placed them in the vase inside the room.

Mo Chen looked at the little wild flowers by the roadside and was momentarily lost in thought.

Many noble and illustrious families valued flower arranging.

Affecting refinement, they would use nothing but various rare and precious flower materials.

Yet his wife was always so unexpected.

She didn't care whether she wore flowers in her hair or jade ornaments, nor whether her clothes were fine silks and satins. Often, with her hair simply coiled up, she bustled about from morning till night.

Not to mention the status of the General's Manor, even the wives of ordinary wealthy merchant households dressed in the utmost extravagance.

In the Tianshu Kingdom, anyone with a shred of fame had rare flowers planted in their courtyards.

Only his wife was simple and unpretentious.

She could always arrange a comfortable and elegant atmosphere out of the simplest things.

Mo Chen looked at her, lost in his own thoughts.

At this moment, Ye Li was sitting at the desk again, writing and drawing.

Mo Chen suddenly felt that he was truly, incredibly lucky.

She was exceptionally skilled at painting, and when she taught, she was more patient than any tutor he had ever listened to.

Going from simple to difficult, she taught him step by step. Everyone in Qingzhu Courtyard praised his rapid progress, but only he knew it was because his wife taught him well.

She never gave him a hard look, even when he was useless.

Instead, she dug out his strengths bit by bit and turned those paintings into martial arts illustrations. Now, many people loved his artwork.

Yet only the people in the General's Manor knew that it was Madam who had retouched them.

Externally, the story was that the General had created them during his leisure time while recovering from illness, and the low price was so that all commoners could afford to view them.

Now, the General's Manor was a world apart from when he first woke up.

Mo Chen's heart was filled with joy, yet he was also terrified that all of this was just a dream.

Perhaps even he himself was nothing more than an illusion...

Unusually, Ye Li noticed that Mo Chen had become reticent today.

In the past, because he was too boisterous and full of energy, bouncing around and dragging her everywhere in the General's Manor to play hide-and-seek, Ye Li had secretly nicknamed him a wild child.

Yet these past few days, he had been quite quiet, often gazing at her silently and losing himself in thought.

Like right now, he sat quietly, his features as picturesque as a painting. The young man was blessed with good looks; even just sitting there watching her made Ye Li detect a hint of deep affection in his eyes.

When they first met, Ye Li had marveled at his good looks, and coupled with the filter of a hero saving a damsel in distress, Ye Li actually harbored a favorable impression of him.

It was just that she didn't belong here after all.

Perhaps due to some accident, her soul would return to the netherworld, and she would be back in modern times.

That was why she remained calm, poised, and resigned to taking care of him, treating it as repaying a debt of gratitude for saving her life.

However...

Will someone please tell her why the young man before her had silently slipped behind her while she was lost in thought?!

A strong masculine scent enveloped her. Mo Chen had actually trapped her in his arms along with the chair, looking down at what she was drawing before asking in bewilderment,

"Are these... skeletons?"

Fearing she might frighten him, Ye Li had no choice but to write on a side note:

"In the art of painting, one must understand the bone distribution of the human body to achieve mastery with the brush."

"This is the skeletal distribution of a normal human body, not the remains of any specific person."

Fearing he was too young to look at such things, Ye Li wrote again:

"Don't be afraid."

"You only need to use it as a general reference. If you really paint, you only paint the surface muscles; you don't need to paint the bones."

Mo Chen said,

"With so many scars on my body, would it look bad if painted..."

He said with trepidation...

Remembering that he had joined the army at a young age and had shielded her from an arrow with his own body at their very first meeting, Ye Li figured his body must be covered in scars.

Unable to bear it for a moment, she comforted him:

"Those are proofs of you defending your country and home, the medals of a hero."

Hearing this, Mo Chen's eyes lit up for a fraction of a second before turning disappointed:

"It's different. I'm most afraid of wife hating me. I'm not like the one in the drawing."

Ye Li shook her head.

As an art academy student, she was as serious and earnest toward her academic studies as ever.

Whether it was a male model or a female model, they were all painted for the sake of studying bones and muscles.

She would never judge whether it looked good or bad, nor would she attach her own emotions to it.

Mo Chen nervously parted his robes, revealing a well-built, sturdy upper body, and murmured pitifully...

"Am I that ugly..."

...Painting is free of carnal desire.

However...

Ye Li deeply felt that if she hadn't felt anything before, it was only because the distance was too far.

Try having eight-pack abs right in front of your eyes like this, with the young man's heart still beating for you...

Heart-melting, sweet-talking sweet nothings poured forth:

"I can't see the bones, and it doesn't look good either, but I really, really like you."

Ye Li: ......

Critical hit to the heart!

Tears streamed from the corners of her mouth as Ye Li wept silently while complaining inwardly:

If you have the guts to flirt with me now, you better have the guts to keep flirting with me after you regain your memory...

chapters.title: The Palace Intrigues Never Cease
chapters.content:
What is obtained from paper is, after all, superficial…

Even when she used to practice, she had gone through the dry practice of human anatomy a thousand and one times,and had read introductory books like Bridgman’s Complete Guide to Drawing from Life and Human Anatomy for Artists.

Yet Mo Chen’s physique offered an entirely different visual impact!

It was fresh, vivid!Alive and breathing!

Stepping carefully beneath his robe was the healthy physique of someone who had practiced martial arts for years, pulsing with a blood-pumping heartbeat. Ye Li noticed that not only was his face red, but even his ears were crimson.

The overwhelming aura of masculine hormones was matched with an innocent, naive gaze as he nervously said, "I like you."

Ye Li understood in her heart that this was a child…

Yet she was terrified that she wouldn't be able to handle this explosive stimulation and would suffer a nosebleed on the spot!

Ye Li quickly turned her head away.

She looked silently at the drawing paper, chanting to herself: "Form is emptiness, emptiness is form."

Yet the dazzling physique she had just caught a glimpse of, as radiant as the sun god Apollo, lingered long in her mind.

As the most handsome male god in ancient Greek mythology, Apollo was also the subject of praise by many artists in poetry and painting.

Although Ye Li did not major in Western art history, she still studied the allusions of Western mythology.

Ye Li thought to herself that although Mo Chen's mind was currently like a child's, she could not take advantage of his amnesia.

She hurriedly lowered her head and continued to refine her demonstration drawing.

Focus on the academics!

If Mo Chen were to wake up and discover that the person to whom he had entrusted his entire life and fortune had actually coveted his body, he would surely despise her.

Fearing that the general would wake up and slash her with a single blade, Ye Li could only focus single-mindedly on continuing her drawing.

Mo Chen, not understanding why, assumed that the scars on his body had frightened his wife.

His mood instantly plummeted into desolation.

As expected…He was still too ugly.

……

The General’s Mansion was exceptionally quiet today.

One felt they couldn't bully the other.The other was terrified the other would loathe them.

In the afternoon, the homework Ye Li assigned to Mo Chen was to draw the skeleton.

She figured that if Mo Chen could accurately copy the skeletal distribution in its entirety, that would be enough.

Yet today, Mo Chen wore a pitiful, bitter expression the entire time.

Ye Li thought he didn't like drawing anymore…

……

Pondering what kind of entertainment would be good?

She suddenly remembered!As a general who marched and fought in wars, he would surely be interested in stories of warfare.

So Ye Li recalled the military strategies of The Thirty-Six Stratagems and the stories from The Art of War by Sun Tzu.

She selected some interesting ones to write down,hoping to relieve the boredom of his dry studies.

Mainly because in her past life she had loved making extra cash, and had once illustrated cultural allusions for publishing houses.

Sure enough, Mo Chen was extremely interested in these war-related topics, and his attention was instantly captured.

Today, not only did he finish the skeletal copy, but he also memorized these short stories.

At the end, he even discussed them with Ye Li:

"I like the story of 'Besiege Wei to Rescue Zhao'; it can reduce casualties."

Ye Li nodded in response to him; she had never experienced such things.

Wars left behind in history books were never as deeply felt as experiencing them firsthand.

Just how cruel war was could be seen by looking after the Green Bamboo Courtyard maintained by the General's Mansion.

Before he was poisoned, Mo Chen had constantly worried about it, hoping that after Ye Li took charge of the General's Mansion, she wouldn't cut off the supplies to the Green Bamboo Courtyard.

She kept all of this in her heart.

At his current age, Mo Chen had a deep interest in storybooks.Especially the stories of military strategy and tactics; he read them with great relish…

When the night grew deep and quiet, Ye Li was already yawning continuously, yet Mo Chen still showed no sign of sleepiness.

Just as he was about to ask his wife a question, he noticed Ye Li squinting her eyes, about to pitch forward.

So he gently stepped forward, caught Ye Li, and let her lean against him.

When she had fallen soundly asleep, he scooped her entirely into his arms and carried her back to the bed in the master bedroom.

His little wife was very light in weight, completely different from the plump figures favored by the noble ladies of the Tianshu Kingdom.

Holding her felt just like holding a little rabbit, and he liked it immensely.

Half-dreaming, Ye Li felt herself embraced by a broad, warm chest, exuding a sense of reassuring comfort.

She subconsciously nuzzled closer, and seeing her drowsy state, Mo Chen liked her even more.

The general who had lost his memory did not know why he had married a wife, but he truly loved someone so soft and gentle, wanting to hold her in the palm of his hand and cherish her always.

The next day.

Just as Ye Li woke up, she found that Mo Chen was holding her tightly in his arms!

Frightened, she shrank back, only to find that his arm holding her still hadn't let go…

The moment Ye Li moved, Mo Chen woke up. Opening his eyes and seeing Ye Li's expression, he very proactively released her, then said sheepishly:

"Last night, Wife accompanied me in drawing, and it got too late, so I carried you over here."

Ye Li blinked her eyes and said in lip-sync:"Why didn't you put me on the daybed?"

Mo Chen said with heartache: "I couldn't bear to."

In an instant, warmth flooded the bottom of Ye Li's heart.

Mo Chen continued:"I wanted to hold my wife while sleeping."

Never mind, don't think too much; I'm just a human-shaped body pillow.

……

Pulling herself together, Ye Li prepared to console herself that the person across from her was merely a seven or eight-year-old child.

She cooked breakfast for Mo Chen as usual, and then the two of them went to the desk, preparing for today's studies.

Because his previous sketches could be sold for money, he practiced with even greater focus, and Mo Chen's progress was now quite obvious.

Today, Ye Li began teaching him how to sculpt facial features.

She wrote on the paper:"Among the facial features, only the eyes are the most important, the lips come second, and the rest, the nose can be appropriately weakened, and the ears come after."

Ye Li explained the anatomical knowledge points one by one, followed by muscle distribution, and finally facial expressions.

Joy, anger, sorrow, and delight were things that had to be drawn.

Ye Li drew the demonstration piece first, then had Mo Chen copy it.

Taking advantage of this time, she went to the side to draw farming equipment as well, intending to make full use of the cultivated land behind the back mountain of the General's Mansion to make more money.

Depending on the mountains when near the mountains, depending on the water when near water; relying on an illustrator, one could enjoy all five thousand years of brilliant Chinese culture.

The two of them concentrated wholeheartedly, and the day passed just like that.

When Ye Li went to check Mo Chen's homework, she drew in a sharp breath…

Mo Chen's homework was already finished, and it had been drawn with extreme care.

Only on top of that, he had also sketched her while she was drawing nearby…

He had also sketched them in the kitchen when Ye Li lifted her veil…He had sketched the scene of Ye Li cooking…

It was done with utmost care and detail; compared to the previous picture books, his current drawing level had progressed at a startlingly rapid speed!

As Ye Li looked and looked, she froze.For a moment, she didn't know what expression to make when facing such a heaven-defying student.

As for Mo Chen, he waited anxiously and apprehensively.

In the past when he drew, although his wife couldn't speak, she would always smile gently and sometimes give him a thumbs-up.

Mo Chen felt that he hadn't performed well today and couldn't draw his wife's beauty; worriedly, he stammered:

"I'm sorry, Wife. I didn't draw well..."

Ye Li wanted to say: Don't, please don't be so modest.Child, how long have you even been studying? Isn't this going against the heavens...

Looking at these images, Ye Li suddenly felt as though she had truly become a husband and wife with him.

The two of them discussed things together, jointly remodeling their home and living a vibrant life.

Just as her mind was wandering, the gatekeeper reported that someone had come from the palace.

Deep inside, Ye Li screamed that this was bad…

After burning the imperial archives, they had returned to the General's Mansion, nominally to recuperate, but in reality to bide their time and cultivate strength.

Yet the palace had always wanted to find out Mo Chen's true condition!

In the blink of an eye, the General's Mansion became lively.

Eunuchs and maidservants carried numerous chests inside, accompanied by music.

Word was that they had paraded around the city for a whole circle, beating gongs and drums to deliver the imperial rewards.

Before long, all sorts of items were displayed in the courtyard of the General's Mansion.

The leading eunuch walked in with a radiant smile and said enthusiastically:"These are rewards from the various consorts, meant to add to the festivities of your newlyweds."

Ye Li had originally thought the imperial rewards would be gold and silver jewelry, but she rare-foundedly discovered that they were mostly books, picture albums, and some scented ointments, spices, and candles, which made her feel rather strange.

The mamasan beside them smiled and said:"These are all delights of the boudoir, hoping the two of you will add to the festivities tonight."

???Add to the festivities???Hold on a minute!

Ye Li's face flushed a brilliant red, spreading all the way up.This… delights of the boudoir… could it be what she thought it meant?

The Emperor had said: "The General and his wife are newly married; naturally, it is time to put the matter of a little general on the agenda."

Without any room for argument, the group lit candles all around the main chambers, and then the mamasan smilingly introduced the uses of these objects.

Such as the most popular vernacular storybooks of the day.Such as the finest scented ointment.Such as the soul-stirring powder.

When Ye Li saw the picture album she had opened up, she realized these were ancient chun-gong (erotic) picture albums.

Thinking about it, this must have been the palace's intention.Giving a mute in marriage to the General wasn't enough; they even wanted the mute to bear an eldest son?

If he were healthy and sound, it would be one thing, but what if the child born turned out to be…Then the General's Mansion would lose all its face, and it would definitely become the talk of aristocratic families.

Ye Li felt that this Emperor truly did not do human things.

Just as she was thinking of a way out, Ye Li turned her head and saw that Mo Chen's face was already flushed red. He was supporting his forehead, looking unwell.

Oh crap, I forgot there's a kid in the house!

After finishing lighting the candles everywhere, the palace people malevolently wished the General and his wife an early birth of a noble son, and then left.

Ye Li walked over, wanting to support Mo Chen, only to see that he could no longer sit steadily; he had squatted down, supporting his forehead with both hands.

Frowning, Mo Chen said:"Wife, I'm uncomfortable."

Ye Li hurriedly poured him a cup of water and then helped him to the bed.

Lying on the bed, Mo Chen curled up into a ball, seeming to have fallen into a semi-conscious state.

Yet his flushed complexion was extremely obvious.

Ye Li felt as if her head was about to explode.

The Emperor was playing dirty games!These candles had definitely been laced with something!

Looking at Mo Chen, Ye Li thought to herself:Don't tell me we're actually going to do-it tonight?

~~~

chapters.title: You Are the Most Important Person to Me
chapters.content:
After Rufeng escorted those people away, he hurriedly blew out all the candles, came back, and said to Ye Li:

"Madam, please wait a moment. I'll go get the antidote."

Hearing that there was an antidote, Ye Li immediately nodded.

She tended to Mo Chen while waiting.

At that moment, Mo Chen opened his eyes, his dark pupils filled with grievance.

Mo Chen whispered, "Wife…" Gone was his usual cheerfulness as he frowned and said he felt miserable.

It made Ye Li's heart ache to see it.

When she had first transmigrated here, Lord General had saved her.Enduring the agony of having an arrow pulled out, he had still not dared to cry out in pain.

How could it not hurt? He had simply endured it all alone in silence.

She took his hand and patted it to comfort him.

She said: "Rufeng has gone to fetch the doctor and the antidote. Just wait a little longer."

Looking at her, Mo Chen nodded obediently.

He stopped speaking, enduring it all alone, and then a single tear silently rolled down his cheek.

It made Ye Li feel both heartbroken and helpless.

Leaving aside whether she was willing to consummate the marriage with him or not, Mo Chen had been poisoned and lost his memory precisely because he wanted to protect her.

Now was not a good time, either.

Yet, looking at someone who was usually so cheerful acting like this, yet still remaining so well-behaved; he hadn't asked her to do anything, nor had he cursed the unfairness of fate; he had simply cried silently.

For a moment, Ye Li could only wait quietly and anxiously.

Just as she thought the palace people were malicious, they hadn't targeted Mo Chen alone with the drug.

Ye Li felt rather uncomfortable herself.

It was just that perhaps because Mo Chen's body had low immunity after being injured, the drug took effect on him faster.

Ye Li touched her own forehead and cheeks, and immediately thought:Should I knock him out? Or knock myself out...

She wasn't given a choice.

Mo Chen said: "Wife, I want to wash my face."

Probably because he had broken into a sweat, Mo Chen was terribly embarrassed, his ears bright red.

Seeing him suffering so immensely, and knowing he was already heavily injured,Ye Li ultimately supported him toward the small pool behind the room.

The bathing pool had been remodeled by Ye Li, because ancients were not fond of bathing.Yet Ye Li was a southerner; taking a bath was just like eating, an essential daily routine.

Previously, when they went through their normal washing routines, everything was peaceful.

Both of them had been affected by the candles and incense sent from the palace, and thus felt unwell.

The path that was usually easy and ordinary was walked with extraordinary slowness today.

As they walked, Mo Chen caught the fragrance on his wife's body and thought it smelled truly wonderful.He forced himself to sober up,clenched his fists…and pushed himself to stay awake.

The two of them staggered all the way to the edge of the pool.

Only at that very moment did he dare to let out a breath of relief.

The cold water surrounding his body eased the potency of the drug.

He felt that he was utterly useless, not only unable to help his wife, but always needing her to take care of him.

Chances were, his wife already loathed him by now.

Mo Chen raised his head, wanting to look at Ye Li.

Only to see that Ye Li was currently flushed all over like a glowing sunset, looking just like a boiled shrimp.

Ye Li recalled that the original owner was just an ordinary girl, and in this era, she was still the least popular type.

Because this nation favored plump women!The nobility all ate until they were plump and round, and people who were too thin were seen as lacking blessings, making it very hard for them to get married.

The original owner whom Ye Li had transmigrated into was not only a mute, but her body wasn't plump either, so she hadn't had many romantic prospects.

Meeting such a situation out of the blue left her completely at a loss as to what to do.

Ye Li walked to the edge of the pool, scooped up some pool water, lowered her face, and washed it with the clear water.

Seeing this sight, Mo Chen was instantly reminded of the poetic line "like a hibiscus rising out of clear water"; it was exquisitely beautiful…

Being young, Mo Chen didn't know what had happened to him, thinking he had been poisoned again, and cried out:

"Wife, did I get poisoned again?"

The youth sat in the pool water, his damp eyes filled with sorrow.

Ye Li shook her head and spoke to him in lip-sync:"You won't die. There's an antidote. Just wait a little longer."

Afraid that his scars would be seen, Mo Chen submerged himself deep in the water, terrified of frightening his wife.

Thus, in Ye Li's eyes, the strapping, robust General was hunched over, hiding in the pool, looking at her with a pitiful gaze.

Yet stubbornly, Ye Li recalled the homework she had looked at and assigned to him earlier that day.

Fierce, passionate sincerity, in the end, divine beauty was hard to resist.

Mo Chen stayed submerged in the water, afraid that Ye Li would see the scars on his body.He was afraid that such a gentle wife wouldn't like the scars on him, afraid that she would despise him.

Guiltily, Mo Chen said to Ye Li:"I'm sorry.""Wife, please don't despise me, okay?""You are the most important person to me. Please don't ignore me..."

His pitiful voice and helpless appearance touched Ye Li's heart, and she nodded.

Just as she was about to ask him if he felt better,unexpectedly, Rufeng finally returned.

He strode in eagerly and happily said:"General, the antidote is here!"

Rufeng only saw the General and his wife sitting behind the screen, chatting.Suddenly struck by an epiphany, Rufeng bashfully placed the bottle on the ground and muttered:"Sorry to interrupt, I'll leave the antidote here."

Then Rufeng bolted away as fast as the wind, trailing a final sentence behind him:"I didn't see anything!"

Only then did Ye Li snap back to her senses!

!!!Rufeng had probably misunderstood something...

chapters.title: Secret Feelings and a Flustered Heart
chapters.content:
Rufeng found the antidote and came over, but he misunderstood the two of them.

The breath Ye Li had just let out in relief caught in her throat again.

If he really was your general, I’d accept it, but he’s still just a baby!

Ye Li wanted to clear up the misunderstanding quickly, lest Rufeng tell the general in the future: "My lady took advantage of you while you had amnesia."

Helplessly, her limbs were too weak for her to climb out of the bank.

Mo Chen was right behind her, wrapping his large arm around his wife’s soft body, and murmured:

"Wife, I feel so uncomfortable."

Ye Li thought to herself: You’ll be fine once you take the antidote, hurry up, child!

Mo Chen didn't move an inch, still holding onto Ye Li.

With his upper garment now open and his body temperature exceptionally high, even in the water, Ye Li could still feel her back burning.

She was scared out of her wits, completely at a loss.

Ye Li pointed at the small bottle. Rufeng had left it on the ground, waiting for them.

Following the direction of her finger, Mo Chen said in a low voice:

"Do you want to go over there?"

Unable to speak, Ye Li nodded, signaling him to go quickly.

Mo Chen nodded obediently, then exerted strength in his arms around the back of her knees, lifting Ye Li straight out of the water in a bridal carry.

Startled, Ye Li instinctively wrapped her arms around his neck.

Mo Chen carried Ye Li to the folding screen and covered her with a dry towel.

Taking advantage of his departure, Ye Li changed out of her soaked clothes.

At this moment, Mo Chen was very obedient and walked straight over to pick up the bottle.

Being considerate, he even poured a cup of water for Ye Li before handing her the pill.

Ye Li quickly swallowed it.

Then she noticed he was just staring at her, not moving.

Ye Li pointed at the bottle.

Mo Chen said in a low voice:

"If I don't take it, I can hold my wife, and my wife won't be angry."

!

You’re just a child, are ancients really this precocious?

It was only in hindsight that she remembered: yes, they actually are...

!!

No, he still had to take it; the things in the palace were a mess.

Who knew if there were any side effects!

Unable to hear Ye Li's inner thoughts, Mo Chen assumed his wife didn't like him acting on his own.

So he lowered his head and said sadly:

"I'll take it."

Then, with an expression as if facing a bitter enemy, he swallowed the antidote.

After taking the medicine, Mo Chen saw that Ye Li was barefoot, so he bent down, picked up a towel, and gently wiped away the moisture from her feet.

This was the first time Ye Li had ever received such treatment.

Ancient times were completely different from modern times. In modern times, if a boy helps tie your shoelaces or does something similar, it can be called gentlemanly behavior.

In ancient times, however, there was a strict distinction between superiors and inferiors; some people were born to be waited on by others. Yet Mo Chen, holding the position of general, was still meticulously careful lest she catch a chill.

Suddenly, she felt that life like this wasn't so bad after all.

Free from worries about food and clothing, cherished by her husband.

But another voice in her head said: "Don't take advantage of him, he has amnesia!"

So Ye Li told herself: "Form is emptiness, emptiness is form..."

Mo Chen watched her. He could read Ye Li's lip movements even without any sound.

Curious, he asked, "Wife, what does 'form is emptiness' mean?"

Startled, Ye Li reached out and covered Mo Chen's mouth.

Good grief! If he said that in such a loud voice, wouldn't the whole world know?!

Are humans essentially repeating machines?

Ye Li began to reflect on herself. Knowing full well that his mind was not fully functioning, she should have watched her words.

Having lost his faculties, Mo Chen had no concept of the separation between men and women.

Earlier, he had been very happy just being able to hold his wife, and at this moment, his wife's hand was pressed against his lips.

The soft, delicate touch pressed together, making his heart flutter.

Mo Chen took hold of Ye Li's hand, pulled it down, and examined it closely. He felt his heart begin to beat wildly.

He looked at it, then kissed it, and laughed cheerfully like a child who had just received a piece of candy:

"Wife, when you get close to me, my heart beats so fast. Do you want to feel it?"

With that, he guided her hand to press against his heart.

Caught off guard, Ye Li was hit by another wave of flirting!

Beneath her hand came the sound of "thump, thump, thump"...

Beating powerfully, one beat after another.

Transmitted through body heat, it was impossible to ignore.

The person before her still had that same face, flashing a bright, dazzling smile with pearly white teeth.

Yet he was laying bare his frank and genuine affection, making Ye Li feel as though even the air was bubbling with pink hues...

Unintentional flirting is the most fatal...

What this man said...

Was... was he really this blunt?

What happened to the traditional subtlety of the ancient people?

Where was the proper distance between men and women?

Every single time, he just went straight in with both hands, hey!

Ye Li couldn't escape, because the sensation beneath her palm grew increasingly intense, signaling that the owner's strong and vigorous heart was beating just for her.

This genuine, crystal-clear display of affection instead left her flustered and at a loss...

An illustrator who had been single since birth for many years, despite her excellent academic research, had truly never experienced anything like this.

Right now, her mental system had crashed and gone numb.

And there wasn't a single emoji left to save the situation!

Looking at Ye Li's dazed little face, Mo Chen suddenly had a flash of inspiration and said brightly:

"I wonder if my heartbeat is the only one like this, or if everyone's is the same?"

With that, his hand naturally pressed against the left side of Ye Li's chest.

Her heart, which was already beating fast because of the young man's sweet words, was now pounding like a trapped deer!

!!!!!!!!

Ye Li's eyes widened in horror!

This question was way out of her league!

She abruptly sprang away, dashed swiftly to the bed in the master bedroom, pulled up the duvet, and buried herself underneath it...

The entire sequence of actions was executed in one smooth motion, leaving Mo Chen momentarily stunned.

Just moments ago in his palm, he could sense his wife's heartbeat; it was even faster than his own.

A wave of warmth welled up in Mo Chen's heart; his wife was so adorable.

He walked over to the bed. Ye Li was hiding under the covers, forming a small mound.

Sitting on the edge of the bed, Mo Chen called out softly, "Wife?"

No response.

He called out again, "Wife?"

Inside the duvet, Ye Li repented. She shouldn't have harbored such strange thoughts about a child.

At the same time, she felt extremely awkward about what Mo Chen had just done.

Although he couldn't really be called intentional, she still had to maintain some modesty.

In ancient times, the separation of men and women was treated with the utmost taboo. Even though they were married, it didn't mean they were bound to stay together forever.

What if he recovered his wits?

Sigh, she’d better never pay attention to him again.

If she let him flirt with her again, she’d be a puppy.

In her past life, Ye Li had been an extremely introverted person and had never been in a relationship. She kept five cats, and her daily interactions mostly consisted of petting them.

Her job as an illustrator didn't require her to go out often, so her social skills were exceedingly poor.

Facing men, she was timid and lacked self-confidence.

She had no idea what Mo Chen's true feelings for her were.

She simply assumed he was just acting like a kid fond of an older sister.

Meanwhile, seeing that Ye Li remained silent for a long time, Mo Chen instantly panicked.

With trembling care, he lifted the corner of the duvet to take a look at his wife.

Only to find that tears were streaming down her face.

A pang shot straight through Mo Chen's heart, and he immediately apologized:

"I'm sorry..."

"Wife, I'm sorry..."

~~~

chapters.title: The Appearance of a Cute Pet, A Joyful Reunion
chapters.content:
Trembling all over with his lips quivering, Mo Chen said to Ye Li:

"I'm sorry..."

Countless "I'm sorry"s echoed in the room, those low murmurs pitiful and utterly helpless.

Mo Chen panicked.

He was truly panicked!

Ye Li was the kindest and gentlest person he had ever met; she would cook delicious food for him, worry if his injuries hurt, and smile sweetly at him.

Yet someone this wonderful had been reduced to tears by his own hands...

My wife, who treated me so well and whom I clearly intended to hold closest to my heart, had accidentally been caused pain and distress by me.

As it turned out, I really am unlovable.

No one could ever like me; I'm nothing more than a jinx who brings disaster to everyone, despised by this entire world...

Sinking deeper into sorrow, Mo Chen muttered apologies while crying in despair.

No one will ever treat me this well again.

Never again.

The whole world hates me!

I'm an unwanted, redundant monster...

Lost in his grief, Mo Chen fell down a rabbit hole of dark and dismal thoughts, to the point where he actually entertained suicidal ideation...

Ye Li had initially been spaced out, and with the medicinal effects wearing off, tears had simply welled up in her eyes.

Hearing Mo Chen's hoarse, sobbing voice, she opened her eyes and saw the usually vibrant Mo Chen sitting beside her, hiccuping, sobbing bitterly, and crying his eyes out in profound anguish.

This was simply...

Confused, Ye Li looked at Mo Chen. He was already injured, and with his emotions fluctuating so violently right now, his overall condition had worsened even further.

His face was as pale as ashes, his lips completely drained of color.

Two trails of clear tears slipped down his pale cheeks, and his tightly furrowed brow was steeped in deep agony.

The "I'm sorry"s on his lips had long since degraded into painful whimpers...

Hadn't he already taken the antidote?

How on earth did things turn out like this?

........................

............

In an instant, or perhaps after a very long time had passed

Time flowed on, and the crying in the room grew louder.

Knowing that he still had unhealed old wounds and that his agitated state was causing his shoulder to seep blood once more,

Ye Li had originally resolved not to pay attention to him, determined not to be helplessly swept away by his flirting while he remained completely oblivious.

Yet at this moment, her heart ultimately softened...

Sigh, I must have owed you a usurious loan in my past life that I failed to pay back.

And now I have to repay the debt with my own body in this one.

Ye Li let out a sigh.

Just as she had done before, she leaned gently against his chest, soothing him with slow, rhythmic strokes, gentle yet firm.

At the same time, she helped wipe away his tears, using a slightly heavier force out of lingering annoyance.

Hmph, a dignified general, and the only thing he knows how to do when faced with trouble is cry!

Little crybaby.

The Lord General, completely unaware that his beloved wife had just given him a nickname, cried until he was hiccuping non-stop.

His body shuddered with every sob; despite his towering build, he now looked as fragile and vulnerable as an abandoned child.

From shock, to helplessness, and finally to sitting quietly beside him, offering silent comfort and companionship...

she had promised herself she'd be a dog if she ever paid attention to him again, but she hadn't expected her words to come back and bite her so quickly...

When Ye Li finally noticed that the commotion had stopped for a while, she found that his eyes were tightly shut, his body twitching slightly as he muttered something and drifted off into a deep sleep...

Mo Chen had cried himself to sleep.

The troublesome kid was finally asleep; that certainly wasn't easy.

She looked at the now-quiet Mo Chen: the corners of his eyes were red, his brow tightly furrowed, and his lonely expression filled with desolation, as if he had been abandoned by the world. Even his sleeping posture was curled inward, shrinking his presence in an instinctive defense mechanism.

Come to think of it, her initial impression of Mo Chen, that he remained tight-lipped and stoic when pierced by arrows and injured, the type to bravely shed blood for his country, had been far too deeply ingrained.

In reality, when looking closely, he didn't speak much and rarely talked about his own affairs.

To her, the past and present of the person before her remained a complete mystery.

who would have thought he cared so much about companionship, shed tears so easily, and wore his emotions so openly on his sleeve?

Ye Li mused that whoever had poisoned him truly was vicious.

Murder was one thing, but torturing someone with such psychological torment...

As the saying goes, a soldier can be killed but not humiliated; such torment must surely feel utterly unforgettable to a military general.

Thinking ahead to when Mo Chen recovered his wits and looked back on these days, he would probably find his current self utterly too painful to recall.

With that thought, Ye Li couldn't help but chuckle softly.

Crybaby.

In her heart, Ye Li bestowed yet another nickname upon the Lord General.

But at that moment, lost in deep slumber, Mo Chen remained entirely unaware.

Night fell.

Tonight was calm and moonless, with only a scattering of starlight hanging high in the heavens, and absolute silence filled the air.

Feeling restless, Ye Li tiptoed out into the courtyard.

Making her way to the edge of the lotus pond, she sat down by the water to catch her breath, casually plucked a leaf, and began to blow on it.

In her past life, her best friend had taught her how to play the flute, but she always forgot the musical scores, so she eventually developed a habit of picking leaves to pass the time whenever she was deep in thought.

A mournful melody drifted through the dark night, sounding exceptionally lonely in the late hours. Ye Li felt that ever since arriving here, there had been far too many things beyond her control and quite a few helpless moments.

Recalling her days in the modern world, ordinary, fulfilling, painting, petting cats, and browsing the internet every day.

For a homebody, that was more than enough.

She wondered how Annie was doing now. Ye Li had given names to all the cats she kept, and now, being in a foreign land, she missed her cats terribly.

She wondered if they were hungry...

Perhaps due to missing them too much, her memories interfered with her hearing, and she fancied she heard Annie's sound.

Sigh, auditory hallucinations had even started now.
