In a daze, Ye Li fancied she heard a "meow" coming from across the pond, and she looked up.

Sure enough.

It was an illusion.

It was completely impossible anyway!

Humans could only cross over with their souls intact, let alone cats.

Just as Ye Li was reminding herself not to slip into senility before her time, she was abruptly startled by two glowing orbs flashing across the opposite bank: "Ghost!"

Ye Li wanted to scream, but she forgot she couldn't make a sound. In an instant, her legs went weak and she fell backward.

How terrifying, what kind of ghost was this?!

The sound of "meow, meow" clearly rang out from the opposite shore once more. Forcing herself to calm down, Ye Li steadied herself and looked closer, drawing in a sharp breath:

"!!!!"

She saw that the glowing objects on the opposite bank were actually a cat's pupils, which under the moonlight at a specific angle reflected a luminescent sheen, flickering in the dark night like will-o'-the-wisps.

In the past, Ye Li had occasionally been startled by cat eyes when getting up to use the bathroom in the middle of the night, but she hadn't expected that coming to ancient times wouldn't spare her from this either.

A startled Ye Li panted heavily. Thank goodness, thank goodness, it was just a cat after all.

"Master, I found you!"

Suddenly, Ye Li heard a voice.

"Master, I've been looking for you for so long!"

Help!

chapters.title: Assisting the Little Cute Pet to Steal the Matchmaker's Job
chapters.content:
Ye Li deeply regretted coming out alone in the dark right now. Her auditory hallucinations were getting so severe!

She thought she heard someone talking to her, but looking all around, there was no one there.

Yet that cat had come over.

That cat, which had been hiding far away in the darkness, actually came over!

And it kept talking to her. Ye Li confirmed she wasn't mistaken; it was a cat, not a ghost.

She stared fixedly in that direction, and when the cat walked up to her feet, her eyes widened in disbelief!

This? ... This was Annie!

There was no mistake, this was Ye Li's cat Annie from before she transmigrated!

Its orange-yellow long fur gleamed softly in the moonlight, as if edged with gold, and its large tail was fluffy and soft. After walking over, the cat trotted straight to Ye Li's feet and rubbed against her leg.

Even the movements were identical!

Ye Li hurriedly bent down to pick up the cat, then looked straight into its eyes: This... these big eyes!

It really was her!

"Master," the little cat said.

Ye Li's heart instantly felt full. She excitedly hugged the cat to her chest, the pleasant surprise of regaining what was lost instantly overflowing her heart. It was too precious!

Annie was fine, wonderful, simply wonderful, and she had even followed her over!

"Master, did you miss me?"

Ye Li excitedly picked up the cat, rubbing her own face against Annie's little face, a sense of satisfaction welling up spontaneously.

She said in her heart: "I missed you! I wonder if the other cats came too?"

The little cat said: "It seems to be just me, I didn't see them."

It was right at this moment that Ye Li discovered!

Not only could she understand what the cat was saying, but the little cat could also hear her inner voice!

Wow! Being able to understand little animals, how amazing is that!

Why didn't I transmigrate sooner!

She was so happy she wanted to carry the cat back to her bedroom, but she found that her legs had gone weak...

...

Frightened weak.

Unable to move, she could only sit and wait.

Embracing a go-with-the-flow attitude, Ye Li quietly waited for her legs to recover.

At that moment, a stick was abruptly placed in front of her.

Mo Chen held the other end of the stick and said cautiously, "Wife, if you don't like me touching you, grab the other end of the stick and I'll pull you up."

Ye Li raised her eyes with slight astonishment and saw Mo Chen standing anxiously nearby.

Mo Chen, who had been hidden in the darkness, didn't know when he had arrived, nor how long he had been there.

It wasn't until he saw Ye Li fall and unable to get up, while worrying that she didn't like him touching her, that in his anxiety he went and got a wooden stick himself, intending to help.

When he extended the wooden stick, he even took a careful step back himself, for fear of angering Ye Li again.

Looking at this stick, Ye Li was filled with a myriad of emotions, her mind a tangle of countless thoughts, unable to sort out what she was feeling.

She sighed and extended her hand.

Hold me.

A silent tacit understanding.

Mo Chen's face instantly blossomed into a smile. He immediately grabbed Ye Li's hand with both hands, clasping her palm tightly, and helped her up as carefully as if she were a precious treasure.

"Wife, I'm sorry, I know I was wrong. If you don't want me to touch you in the future, I won't touch you." Mo Chen promised earnestly, looking just like a child.

In truth, Ye Li didn't have much anger left. She had been broad-minded since she was a child, big-hearted and easy-going, you see. No matter how unhappy things were, once she finished crying, that was the end of it.

She curved the corners of her mouth, smiled at Mo Chen, and nodded, considering today's matter settled.

A forgiving heart brings a century of peace.

A blissful smile bloomed at the corners of Mo Chen's mouth. He held Ye Li's hand and pressed it preciously against his chest, intending to head back together.

Then Mo Chen saw Ye Li still holding the cat, looking at Annie with a furrowed brow.

Ye Li tilted her head: What's wrong?

She saw that Mo Chen's entire face spelled unhappiness, his lips pursed high, his cheeks puffed out like a hamster's, as he said with disgusted disdain: "So dirty."

Ye Li shook her head, wanting to indicate that cats clean themselves to keep their fur dry, and she didn't mind.

However, the next second, Mo Chen leaned close to her, resting his forehead against hers, and suggested earnestly and gravely: "She's dirty, I'm not dirty. Wife, you can cuddle with me."

His tone carried a strong sense of possessiveness, as if he had suffered some great grievance.

Ye Li's face flushed red "in a flash." This, this, this...

This distance was simply too close!

Although she had interacted with Mo Chen before, they had never been this intimately close.

At this moment, their noses were almost touching, their breaths intertwined. Ye Li could see her own reflection shining brightly and crystal-clear in his phoenix eyes. Their lips could touch if moved forward just a bit, and Ye Li could even feel his scorching breath!

Ah, ah, ah, ah, ah...

Invisible flirting is the most lethal!

She tried to hold her breath, but her heart pounded like thunder, its deafening sound roaring as if it were about to burst out of her chest. She was so nervous her palms were sweating.

The little cat Annie also said unhappily, "Master, hurry and tell him, I'm not dirty at all!"

Ye Li had no choice but to patiently explain to him. Gently holding Mo Chen's hand, she wrote in his palm: "I raised her before. She's not dirty. Let's raise her together from now on."

Ye Li didn't know if the memory-loss Mo Chen could understand what she wrote.

Fortunately, only his intellect was impaired; common sense things were still understood.

Mo Chen was initially curious about Ye Li's actions. When she finished writing completely, realizing that because his wife couldn't speak, she was using handwriting to chat with him, he smiled even more happily.

The corners of his mouth curled into an exaggerated arc as he said brightly and enthusiastically:

"Since this is what my wife raised before, then we'll raise it together from now on! Just the two of us, you and me."

He even deliberately emphasized that it was just the two of them, then looked at the cat as if finding it a reluctant necessity.

"But how did my wife end up raising a creature like this?"

Mo Chen said in bewilderment:

"This wild beast is fiercely aggressive and cunningly elusive. I've never seen anyone domesticate such a beast. Fur beasts are only ever used for their pelts to make scarves and fox-fur coats. If you want a pretty scarf, I can give you mine."

Only then did Ye Li realize that the ancient times lacked the concept of pets. Either hunters stripped fox and tiger skins, or game went into bellies; keeping animals was for utility rather than emotional companionship.

Fearing Mo Chen would misunderstand, she hurriedly wrote in his palm:

"I don't need any gifts. I like cats, I just want to keep one, to keep her by my side."

The little cat also chimed in: "I only eat very little! I'll stay by Master's side and be good."

Although Mo Chen didn't understand meow-meow language, he was still very obedient.

So he looked at Annie squarely and said, "Alright then, as long as my wife likes it."

"But you can't let her get this close to you."

Ye Li wrote helplessly: "But I'm used to holding her, and she won't hurt people. She's very good and gentle, it's fine to keep her around."

"No, no, no, Wife, you can't do this. You don't even hug me when I don't bite, yet you go hugging such a dangerous wild beast. That won't do, unless you hug me whenever you hug her!"

Ye Li was terrified by his child-like spoiled behavior and had no choice but to agree.

Only then did Mo Chen smile with satisfaction, looking as if his goal had been achieved, radiating happiness all over.

Seeing him finally coaxed into satisfaction, Ye Li breathed a sigh of relief, feeling in a daze as if the person opposite her had two ears popping out of the top of his head, happily wagging like a large, loyal dog...

Under the moonlight, the two stood very close, and the atmosphere in the air instantly turned tender and ambiguous.

The cat named Annie seemed extremely displeased with this man who had barged in to disturb her and her master. She bared her teeth and let out a demonstrative "meow" at the unfamiliar man.

Then she licked Ye Li's face.

The little cat said: "I can be in Master's arms, and I can also kiss Master."

Mo Chen, who had been happy just now, suddenly flashed an odd look in his eyes, as if a door to a new world had been opened. He copied the action and licked Ye Li's face, then ran over to the other side where the cat had licked, wiped it with his hand, and licked it again.

Ye Li froze, completely failing to react, her mind going blank.

Just now, amidst Mo Chen's movements, his breath suddenly drew close, and the tip of his nose brushed against Ye Li's ear, sending ripples of numbness and a tremor through her.

Having a precedent, Mo Chen now acted as if he had done something wrong. He drifted his eyes into the distance, not daring to look at Ye Li, and mumbled in a voice as low as a mosquito's hum:

"Because it licked once, I have to lick twice. I have to protect my wife."

!!!!!!!!!!

The little cat was furious: "Meow-meow punches attack!"

~~~

chapters.title: The Completely Opposite General Lord
chapters.content:
The little cat Annie immediately swung her little fists to deal a fierce beatdown, alas, the "meow-meow punches" missed because her arms were too short.

She failed to hit him.

"Abominable!" Annie roared.

But to Mo Chen's ears, the cat had merely let out a "meow."

Utterly devoid of threat.

Mo Chen looked at Ye Li cautiously. He had timidly expected his wife to fly into a towering rage, but what met his eyes instead was a portrait of a beauty lowering her gaze.

He watched her face flush red like the evening glow, her moist eyes brimming with shy modesty, and her long eyelashes batting like little fans, fanning the flames in his heart even higher...

"Wife, your face is so red..."

Mo Chen abruptly felt his lips go dry, swallowed unconsciously, and muttered in a hoarse murmur:

"My heart is beating so fast because of you."

With that, he still wanted Ye Li to touch his heart, as if he absolutely had to prove his sincerity.

Ye Li was once again provoked by his straightforward and open boldness until her whole body shuddered. She turned around directly, broke into a trot, and ran away swiftly.

Good grief!

She had been flirted with by an intellectually impaired child!

Could you please stop radiating charm with that handsome face of yours...

Walking hurriedly away, Ye Li ran in a panic, and after only a few steps in the dark, she tripped and fell.

Wuwu, I hate this ancient society without streetlights!

Who would have known that right before she fell, Mo Chen flew forward, threw himself onto the ground, and caught her!

Mo Chen voluntarily acted as a human cushion, providing her with a buffer. In his arms, Ye Li couldn't help but secretly marvel:

Young man, fine kung fu!

But!

Why didn't you hug my waist or something?

Why did you choose to be a human flesh cushion?!

So in the end, I still fell, and even crushed you.

In his haste, Mo Chen had chosen to protect her tightly, enveloping her outer layer with his own body.

All the impact and cushioning were taken by him...

Although it wasn't as romantic as imagined, this trope of a hero saving the damsel in distress was truly, solidly handsome!

This feeling of being held in someone's heart brought tears welling up in her eyes!

It's just that his method was a bit clumsy.

After catching Ye Li, Mo Chen carefully checked to see if she was injured.

Then, struck by a flash of inspiration, he scooped Ye Li up in a bridal carry and carried her directly back to her room.

This valor added a touch of masculine vigor to his amnesiac self...

Annie the cat had great balance; when Ye Li fell, she had already prepared her posture for landing.

She hadn't expected her master not to fall.

The cat said: "Is this that hero saving the beauty from TV? Master, your womb-to-grave single status finally has someone wanting you!"

Ye Li thought to herself: "...Alright, life is already hard enough, let's not expose certain things. Understand?"

Ye Li wrapped her arms around Mo Chen's neck, snuggling in his embrace. In this broad and powerful embrace, a feeling called reassurance suddenly arose.

Immediately afterward, Ye Li recalled that even at the very beginning when the two of them were completely unacquainted, when there was neither an engagement nor any intersection between them, Mo Chen had still protected her, a commoner's daughter.

It was he who had rescued her in passing when assassins were trying to slaughter Ye Li indiscriminately, which then led to many subsequent events.

The past cannot be pursued, but the fact that they could meet in the midst of millions of people was perhaps a destined affinity in the mortal world after all.

Mo Chen carried her all the way back to her room in brisk strides. He gently placed Ye Li on the bed and tucked her in with utmost care and reverence.

Then he glanced at the cat, intending to grab Annie and throw her out.

Ye Li hurriedly tugged at his sleeve and gently pulled the cat back, \"It's fine for her to sleep with me.\"

"That's right, I want to sleep with Master!" Annie said.

Unexpectedly, Mo Chen kicked up a fuss the next instant. He put his hands on his hips and objected anxiously:

"No, no, no, she can't sleep here!"

"Don't worry, she won't hurt me." Ye Li wrote patiently.

"Then I want to sleep with you too! Otherwise it's not fair!"

Mo Chen leaped directly onto the bed, guarding Ye Li's side.

He stated with absolute certainty that he was determined to stay here and accompany her.

Seeing that he was dead-set against it and extremely persistent, Ye Li felt helpless.

Oh well, oh well, they had already shared a bed when she first transmigrated anyway.

It was no different now.

All sounds were dead silent, the time for deep sleep.

Yet on this night, having faced the wall and lain down for who knows how long, having counted sheep that had circled the General's Mansion many times over, Ye Li still couldn't fall asleep...

Damn it, she had insomnia!

Instinctively feeling that a gaze had been lingering on her for a long time, Ye Li raised her eyes and found Mo Chen staring straight at her. Turns out, he hadn't fallen asleep either.

The two stared at each other until Ye Li was the first to grow shy.

Mo Chen saw the color of the evening glow bloom across Ye Li's fair face, gorgeous, enchanting, and dripping with allure, as if inviting crime.

Unable to bear Mo Chen's naked gaze, Ye Li could only turn around again, her back facing Mo Chen.

Thinking to herself that the distance was too close, this level of visual beauty crit was an absolute visual impact explosion!

She was afraid that if she looked a few more times, her feverish face would cause her nosebleeds to run.

I beg you, stop radiating this damned charm!

Annie the cat heard Ye Li's inner voice. Cats don't sleep at night; they only like to sleep basking in the sun during the day.

She shifted into a comfortable position and said calmly:

"Master, don't be shy. This is your man, do whatever you want."

Ye Li said in her heart: "I suspect you're driving, but I have no proof."

The dialogue between human and cat was entirely silent, so Mo Chen couldn't hear it.

After Ye Li turned her back, Mo Chen could no longer see her face.

However, possessing excellent night vision, the General Lord saw that Ye Li's ears were red, looking just like rabbit ears.

He inwardly exclaimed: "So cute."

Mo Chen could now empathize with why Ye Li wanted to touch the cat's long fur, because he really, really wanted to touch his wife's cute little ears...

The General Lord had always been prompt and resolute, and even with amnesia, he remained the same.

So Mo Chen, thinking this, actually took action.

With her brain in a complete fog, Ye Li felt someone gently stroking her ears.

A tingling, numbing thrill instantly spread through her entire body. The spot where her ear tip was touched was extremely sensitive, and the intense stimulation instantly rushed straight to her sensitive points.

Ye Li didn't want to face it and had originally made up her mind to play dead, but this kind of stroking was simply too agonizingly teasing!

The tingling, numbing sensation lingered persistently and showed a trend of intensifying.

With no outlet for her feelings, she had no choice but to grab Annie the cat, attempting to divert her attention by petting the cat.

Cats loved being petted everywhere on their bodies.

So at this moment, Annie purred in comfort, a rumbling sound vibrating in her throat. When feeling happy, she even pointed out which spot needed improvement and where more pressure could be applied.

Thus, to Mo Chen's ears, it sounded like the cat was letting out alluring cries one after another, replacing the young maiden's original bashfulness.

Mo Chen felt that perhaps the cat was still somewhat useful after all; he didn't dislike it anymore.

Ye Li felt a movement behind her, and suddenly Mo Chen's deep and magnetic voice traveled to her ear.

Unawares, he had drawn so close; Ye Li felt as though his words were echoing right beside her ear.

"Wife?"

...

"Wife?"

Mo Chen called out to Ye Li repeatedly, his heavy breathing brushing against her ear, gentle yet persistent.

Suppressed lust seemed on the verge of erupting, yet sounded like a lover's murmur, restrained and forbearing.

Amidst the unyielding, relentless calls, Ye Li had no choice but to turn around.

She looked at him, then slowly felt around for his hand and wrote gently: "What is it?"

Receiving Ye Li's response, Mo Chen said with yearning:

"I just wanted to call your name, wanted to look at you."

Annie the cat said: "Master, I bet a pack of spicy strips, he likes you."

Mo Chen continued:

"You've been facing the beast the whole time, you like it very much, but I also really want to look at you. Can you turn back around?"

Ye Li couldn't help but write with a sigh:

"So I'm just a humanoid pet?"

"Meant specially for you to look at and pet?"

Mo Chen said:

"What's a pet? I like my wife, I don't like pets."

Ye Li wrote again: "Then why do you like me? What do you like about me?"

Being flirted with every day is truly too much to handle!

Mo Chen wore a proud and haughty smile as he leaned closer and closer, as if the next second, their lips would touch.

"Because, Wife is a good person."

Ye Li: ???

May I ask if this is the meaning I think it is?

chapters.title: Bizarre Intrigues in the Deep Palace, Probing the Illness
chapters.content:
Ye Lixin thought of all the possible answers she might hear, but she never expected it to be this.

Why, did you cross over too?

Annie the little kitten complained:

"Humans are so troublesome, if you like someone, just go for it!"

"Handing out Good Guy cards while hesitating like this, young man, your future fate is definitely a one-way ticket to the Crematorium of Chasing Your Wife!"

Having unexpectedly received a Good Guy card, Ye Lixin was left with a massive question mark in her head.

???

However, Mo Chen was practically pressed against her at that moment, the airflow between their breaths blowing across her face.

It was utterly ambiguous, making Ye Lixin's face flush even redder.

This distance! It's a foul...

The youth's magnetic whisper came from beside her ear:

"Wife will smile at me, will make delicious food, is always quietly well-behaved, and will never beat or scold me."

"Every time I see Wife, my heart beats so fast, as if it's about to jump out..."

"Did... did you hear it?"

The youth's voice was nervous and uneasy, yet carried an inexplicable urgency, as if he feared she didn't understand.

He once again took her hand and placed it against his own chest, the scorching body temperature feeling like fire.

It burned Ye Lixin so much that she wanted to escape, but she was firmly pinned down, unable to move a muscle.

Mo Chen's deep voice echoed repeatedly in the dark night, like a temptation.

It also carried the refreshing, sweet coolness of spring grass unique to a youth, seeming to waver between wickedness and righteousness:

"It would be great if Wife could stay with me forever."

He asked cautiously:

"Will you... stay with me forever?"

His gaze stared at her stubbornly, not wanting her to escape, as if the answer mattered greatly.

At this moment, Ye Lixin's thoroughly blushed cheeks and slightly watery lips made him unable to help swallowing hard, his burning gaze seeming as though it would burn her to ashes.

Ye Lixin was at a loss; no one had ever asked her this before, and she didn't know how to answer.

"Wife, you'll stay with me forever, right?"

The deep voice in the dark night was like a demon's temptation, persistent and resolute, slowly probing the chambers of her heart.

Beneath her palm, Ye Lixin felt the fiery temperature of his chest and his violent heartbeat.

Sinking into Mo Chen's puppy-like expression, she couldn't bear to refuse.

After a long while, she blushed and responded softly:

"Mn..."

Just this single sound, as soft as a mosquito's hum.

Yet Mo Chen seemed immensely encouraged; the youth's voice now sounded as if he had eaten honey, his tone imbued with a cloying sweetness.

While stroking her, he lowered his voice and said:

"I won't leave either. I like Wife the most!"

Before Mo Chen could finish speaking, Ye Lixin used her hand to block his lips, pressing the rest of his words against her palm.

Ye Lixin was simply too embarrassed; Mo Chen didn't know the little cat could hear their conversation, so she covered his mouth, which was flying wild with sweet nothings, and made a "shh" sound to signal him to stop talking.

Ye Lixin wrote on his palm:

"It's late in the night, let's rest. Go to sleep."

Then she turned her back to him, deciding not to turn around for the entire rest of the night!

Annie watched their interaction from the side, jumped up, and bluntly said:

"Humans are so troublesome. If you fancy someone, you should just make your move."

Little cat Annie walked over to Ye Lixin's pillow and sat down. Ye Lixin skillfully scooped her into her arms and gently stroked her fur.

Ye Lixin thought to herself: You can't really put it that way. Humans have greater emotional needs; they hope to have the companionship of one person for a lifetime.

Seeing this scene, Mo Chen's eyes flashed with a peculiar look. He suddenly leaned forward, pressing his body close to Ye Lixin, and imitated her by gently stroking from her cheek and shoulder all the way down to her waist.

Ye Lixin blocked his hand, not letting him continue moving, but she heard his voice in her ear:

"It's late in the night, let's rest. Go to sleep."

………………

！！！！！！

Who on earth is the one not sleeping?!

Ye Lixin was beyond complaining.

Little cat Annie excitedly said:

"Sleep, sleep, what is sleep for? Get up and party!"

Cats were nocturnal animals; in truth, she wasn't sleepy at all, she was just accommodating her owner's schedule.

Mo Chen couldn't understand the cat's speech; he only heard a 'meow' sound, so he fiercely threatened:

"Shh! Don't disturb my wife's sleep."

Mo Chen's hand didn't stop; he continued to stroke slowly. Startled by his movements, her body instinctively shrank back to escape, but because the bed wasn't very large to begin with, this only brought their skin into even closer contact, as if she were throwing herself into his arms.

Ahhhhh, what a huge misunderstanding!

At Mo Chen's age, he naturally liked having a little companion to play with. Feeling as though he had been encouraged, his large arm swept out and locked her tightly in his embrace.

In the midst of these movements, he touched the cat. Going from aversion to acceptance took only a fraction of a second, so he casually stroked the cat along with her.

Mo Chen held her from behind, cradling her petite body in his arms as if she were a rare treasure in this world, and called out to her in a low voice:

"Wife."

"I like you."

Over the past few days, the youth had said this over and over again. His voice was cool, slightly hoarse yet pleasant, carrying genuine sincerity in the dark night.

Catching one off guard...

Impossible to defend against!

Mo Chen gently groped her hand, then interlocked his fingers with hers.

Ye Lixin's heart skipped a beat, and she instinctively wanted to pull her hand away, but he gripped it even tighter, his thumb seemingly rubbing lightly across her palm.

Like a puppy, he sniffed her all over, then took her hand and smelled it again.

A satisfied Mo Chen let out a muffled chuckle from his chest, raised his handsome brow bones, and said softly:

"Wife smells so good, even her scent is my favorite."

Tonight, Mo Chen relentlessly pestered Ye Lixin, hugging and stroking her for a long time. Ye Lixin thought that actually, she was the pet after all!

In the end, Ye Lixin failed to fall asleep successfully.

Because he had too much stamina!

Coupled with the fact that cats were naturally most active at night, Annie's noises kept echoing in her ear all night long.

It wasn't until dawn was approaching that Ye Lixin finally managed to close her eyes for a brief nap.

Yet shortly after, the sound of knocking and banging completely shattered that peace.

The General's Mansion had received another bestowal from the Emperor!

All the imperial treasures formed a procession that circled the city the entire way round. This grand and mighty bestowal let the whole city's commoners see the emperor's high regard and partiality toward the general, before finally arriving at the General's Mansion amidst the sound of gongs, drums, and festive music.

As the newlywed General's Wife, Ye Lixin had no choice but to bear dark circles under her eyes to receive the imperial decree.

After the long and tedious ceremony, the eunuch smiled fawningly at Mo Chen and the sleep-deprived Ye Lixin, saying:

"The Emperor has bestowed so much. Later on, the General and the General's Wife should enter the palace to kowtow in gratitude."

Ye Lixin gave a start, enter the palace?

Ye Lixin thought to herself that it was over; the Emperor must have discovered something and wanted to summon them into the palace to test them out.

When the eunuch finished speaking, he prepared to hand the imperial decree over to Mo Chen, but Mo Chen remained utterly indifferent.

He treated the rewards covering the floor as nothing, staring only at Ye Lixin.

She motioned for him to take the imperial decree, but unexpectedly Mo Chen had no intention of taking it at all, saying dismissively:

"Just leave it there, you can go now. My wife and I are going to eat."

Ye Lixin was so frightened her palms broke out in sweat. The Emperor obviously harbored malicious intentions, so why was he giving such an obvious handle to others?!

It wouldn't take much more than a charge of disrespect to chop her head off!

She hurriedly grabbed Mo Chen's hands, guided them to take the imperial decree, and then put it away.

She couldn't speak, but fortunately in ancient times, gold was hard currency. She fished out a piece of jewelry Rufeng had prepared for her, shoved it into the eunuch's hand, and smiled.

Seeing that she knew how to play the game, the eunuch smiled and nodded.

Ye Lixin shoved another piece into his hand. As the saying goes, courtesy costs nothing.

The eunuch, who previously possessed an arrogant posture, beamed and pushed the items back with faux reluctance:

"Oh my, this is just my duty, how could I dare..."

Even as he said this with his eyes and mouth, his hands tightly tucked the gold into his bosom.

His mouth didn't stop heaping praises like "The General's Wife is truly sensible" and "Lord General is truly blessed."

Since Ye Lixin couldn't speak anyway, she could only perfunctorily smile and nod at this moment.

Suddenly, she felt a gust of wind rush past her side, and the eunuch in front of her was knocked flat on his back.

Mo Chen had lunged forward in a single stride, then kicked the eunuch down with one foot:

"You are not allowed to take it!"

Ye Lixin was dumbfounded!

Mo Chen had beaten the imperial eunuch!

Then Mo Chen nonchalantly snatched the things back from the eunuch's bosom.

He proceeded to put the jewelry back onto Ye Lixin's head himself.

Mo Chen carefully tidied up Ye Lixin's hair and said gently:

"No one is allowed to bully you."

"I will protect you."

~~~

chapters.title: A Single Sentence Turns the Tide
chapters.content:
Mo Chen had kicked the eunuch flying and retrieved Ye Lixin's jewelry.

Little did he know that Ye Lixin was sweating profusely from his bold act...

The renowned general had not only lost his memory, but he had also beaten the Emperor's man, and to top it all off, they still had to enter the palace to face the Emperor later!

Was this messy situation still salvageable?

That unlucky eunuch was thrown to the ground, howling in pain.

Mo Chen's voice sounded once more, mixed with the youth's unique innocence and obvious irritation:

"Interrupting my wife's breakfast, and even trying to take my wife's things?!"

"Get lost!"

Ye Lixin pressed a hand to her forehead...

A courtyard full of servants and maids had heard Mo Chen's roar.

Though they were originally supposed to keep their heads down and eyes lowered, these servants couldn't help raising their heads to sneak a peek.

They saw that the General was dressed in a moon-white robe today, matched with a white jade crown that made his white garments flutter. His cuffs and hem were embroidered with subtle bamboo stalks, naturally radiating the demeanor of a scholar, which neutralized the murderous aura of a military commander who had spent years bathing in blood.

At this moment, his handsome brows were tightly locked, his face stern, and his handsome visage was written full of displeasure.

His hands were tightly circled around Ye Lixin, yet he didn't dare pull her fully into his embrace, treating her with such precious care as if he feared startling the porcelain doll in his arms.

Never had they expected that Mo Chen's unusual and transcendent, fresh image would actually cause quite a few maidens of marriageable age to secretly blush.

Whispers were quietly passed among the palace maids:

"I never thought the General would be so protective of his wife! That is so sweet!"

"The General loves his wife so much, the Wife is truly so blessed!"

"Wuwuwu, I'm so envious! I heard the Wife was just an ordinary commoner whom the General rescued before marrying her."

"Wuwuwu, why wasn't I the one who got hurt? I'd be willing to let them stab me dozens of times for this!"

Mo Chen was originally the youngest and most prominent general in the Tianshu Kingdom, achieving legendary status by winning battles against superior numbers. Unfortunately, having achieved fame at a young age, he was always guarding the borderlands and rushing onto the battlefield.

Even upon returning to the capital, he rarely attended various official gatherings and banquets, so both inside and outside the palace, many people had only ever seen the general's hurried silhouette and had never heard tales of him outside of his military exploits.

Hearing him passionately rebuke the eunuch's actions and display such fierce protection of his wife at this moment, many secretly felt envy, and a low commotion spread among the various maids.

Not long after, rumors of Mo Chen doting on his wife quietly spread throughout the capital.

Meanwhile, Mo Chen was still angry that Ye Lixin's jewelry had been taken by the eunuch. The eunuch grimaced as he crawled back up.

Then, clutching his face, he tremblingly begged for mercy:

"This slave is wronged, this slave merely thought the Wife was bestowing a generous reward upon this slave."

With that, he glanced at Ye Lixin with a puzzled look in his eyes, acting submissively:

"Who could have known this was the Wife's cherished treasure? Had this slave known earlier, I would never have dared to covet it. It's all a misunderstanding, a misunderstanding!"

Unhappy, Mo Chen kicked him again and said coldly:

"No matter what it is, no one is allowed to harbor desires for my wife!"

Seeing him repeatedly beating the eunuch and unable to stop him, Ye Lixin had no choice but to step in front of him.

She tried to stop him, signaling him not to hit the man anymore.

Having been repeatedly scolded and thrown to the ground, a surge of suppressed anger rose in the eunuch's chest.

He instantly dropped his submissive act, put on an arrogant expression, and said sinisterly:

"Lord General, even though you have merits in the imperial court, this slave is also a person by the Emperor's side, representing the royal dignity!"

"You have punished this slave time and time again; are you trying to use this to express some sort of dissatisfaction toward the Emperor?"

"Or does the General simply lack respect for the Emperor and is using this to vent?"

Mo Chen looked puzzled: "What Emperor?"

In full view of everyone, as soon as Mo Chen let those words out, all the servants drew in a sharp breath of cold air.

Hearing this, Ye Lixin thought: This is a huge disaster!

Others didn't know he had amnesia now; pulling a stunt like this would turn a non-issue into a catastrophe!

She hurriedly covered his mouth, trying to communicate using lip movements.

She hoped the ever-victorious General had learned this kind of reconnaissance skill in the past.

She spoke his name as slowly as possible, "Mo Chen, can you read this?"

Seeing his wife's mouth move, that cherry-like mouth opening and closing to reveal sweet loveliness, Mo Chen broke into a happy smile:

"Wife, as long as you speak to me, even without a sound, I can read it!"

Ye Lixin breathed a sigh of relief. Time was of the essence, so she quickly said:

"This eunuch cannot represent the royal dignity. There is a loophole in those words."

"You can question him repeatedly."

Mo Chen gently kissed the palm of his wife pressed against his lips, the anger that had swelled from his possessiveness dissipating slightly.

He nodded, thinking: My cute wife chatting with me without a sound, she's so adorable.

So he turned around, looked coldly at the eunuch, and said:

"Are you an imperial prince? Are you able to represent the royal dignity?"

The eunuch's previously arrogant face instantly wilted as he stammered:

"This slave... naturally is not... but General, don't change the subject. You punished this slave on a pretext; are you trying to vent your dissatisfaction toward the Emperor?"

As if he hadn't heard, Mo Chen continued to ask him:

"Are you an imperial prince? Are you able to represent the royal dignity?"

The eunuch's complexion turned dead, ghastly white as he said:

"This slave... this slave... is not..."

Remembering what his wife had said about questioning him repeatedly, Mo Chen kept his face cold and asked once more:

"Are you an imperial prince? Are you able to represent the royal dignity?"

By now the eunuch was so frightened his legs turned to jelly, and he dropped straight to his knees...

The courtyard full of servants and palace maids, who had been kneeling on the ground, now watched as the usually arrogant eunuch was scared out of his wits, prompting them to whisper among themselves once again:

"The General is truly majestic; he managed to control the situation with just a single sentence!"

"That eunuch often bullied people by throwing his weight around, and plenty of people have been bullied by him. Who would have thought that evildoers finally got what was coming to them!"

As for the eunuch, he had already lost his mind with fright.

Thinking Mo Chen was just a brute who only knew how to fight, he had relied on his position serving by the Emperor's side to show off, never expecting to dig his own grave and lift a rock only to drop it on his own feet...

In the past, this General was the most ignorant of such court rituals and rules.

How was it that today he unexpectedly knew how to strike a snake by hitting its seven inches? If he had been like this in the past, how could he have been exiled for so many years to do the bitter chore of guarding the borderlands?

Filled with remorse, the eunuch fell silent.

The previously tense atmosphere was instantly dissipated by Mo Chen with just a single sentence.

Seeing that the fox-assisting eunuch had been scared out of his wits, Ye Lixin summoned the little cat Annie.

Once out, the cat fiercely leaped in front of the eunuch, bared her claws, and scratched him mercilessly!

The eunuch was struck pale with fright, after which the cat assumed a haughty posture, leaped up, and landed on Ye Lixin's shoulder.

Her imposing aura was fierce, looking just like a divine beast protecting its master, making everyone present feel a chill in their hearts...

What on earth was the background of this General's Wife?

She was actually able to tame a golden silk tiger that no one had ever been able to tame!

Ye Lixin tugged on Mo Chen's sleeve, and Mo Chen was overjoyed, saying with delight:

"Wife, let's go eat breakfast."

Ye Lixin nodded, and the two of them walked into the kitchen as if no one else was around.

They left behind a courtyard full of gift-delivering servants and a panicked eunuch.

Under the scorching sun, the group from the palace never expected to wait the entire morning.

In the end, the eunuch sent someone else to invite the two of them into the palace to kowtow in gratitude.

After hearing this, Mo Chen glanced at them indifferently and said:

"I'm not going."

Ye Lixin thought about it; now was definitely not a good time to enter the palace.

At this moment she couldn't speak, and Mo Chen had lost his memory. If they entered the palace, their weaknesses would inevitably be exposed.

Furthermore, the Emperor had forcefully bestowed the marriage back then, and didn't seem like a particularly enlightened ruler either.

Entering the palace right now was akin to walking into a tiger's den; it was better not to go.

So she employed a mandatory skill she had seen in palace intrigue dramas of the past...

Softly and weakly, she fainted...

Mo Chen cried out in alarm: "Wife!"

As delicate and boneless as a willow catching the wind, Ye Lixin collapsed and fainted right before everyone's eyes...

chapters.title: The General Defends His Wife, Famed Throughout the Capital
chapters.content:
Ye Li feigned illness, weakly collapsing onto the table.

Startled, Mo Chen shouted frantically, "Wife! Wife!"

Rufeng hurriedly instructed the servants to fetch the estate physician, and the residence was instantly plunged into a state of emergency.

The doctor hurried over in quick strides, looking anxious.

The eunuch was sent stumbling and falling once again, jostled by the coming and going of the servants and the physician.

Ye Li quietly opened her eyes, blinked playfully at Mo Chen, and then mouthed the words:

"Tell him we're not feeling well, so we won't be entering the palace for now."

The eunuch could not hear Ye Li's voice, but Mo Chen was keeping his eyes fixed on his little wife. Seeing her "speak" again, his initially happy face abruptly grew quite tense as the words were delivered.

Without a moment's hesitation, Mo Chen anxiously said, "Wife! Where are you feeling unwell?"

Afraid of giving the game away, Ye Li had no choice but to carry on the act to the end, remaining lying on the bed.

She mouthed to Mo Chen:

"It's fake, but please tell this eunuch that both of us are feeling unwell, our old injuries have not healed and new ones have been added, and we can't get out of bed. We will enter the palace to thank the Emperor another day."

It was the first time Ye Li had mouthed such a long sentence, and she wasn't sure if he would understand. To her surprise, he did.

As expected of an undefeated general, he certainly had his skills!

She saw Mo Chen's brow furrow tightly. As soon as she finished speaking, he immediately said to the eunuch:

"My wife and I are not feeling well and cannot get out of bed. We will enter the palace once we recover."

Upon hearing this, the eunuch thought: Mo Chen is sick and won't enter the palace?

If so, then his disrespectful remarks toward the royal family today would not reach the Emperor's ears.

As if grasping a straw in the middle of despair, he hastily fawned, "Since the General's injuries have not healed, naturally he needs a good rest. I will explain things properly to His Majesty."

With that, the eunuch oiled the soles of his feet and hurried away in a rush, as if chased by some ferocious beast.

Once outside the courtyard gate, he let out a breath, resumed his smug and haughty expression, and departed after ordering the attendants and palace maids to put away the gifts.

As he walked, the eunuch was turning over his own abacus: as long as the General remained sick for a sufficiently long time, the Emperor would never find out about his offense against the royal family, and this crime of lese-majeste would simply fade away into nothingness...

What a brilliant method!

Therefore, the eunuch decided to return and exaggerate the General's illness, ideally ensuring the Emperor wouldn't think to summon him for three to five months.

From then on, all sorts of rumors spread throughout the streets: the General's wife was frail, unable to care for herself, and severely ill, while the General had worn himself out caring for her and had fallen sick from exhaustion as well.

There were also whispers among the common folk that the General's wife was terribly ugly, skinny, and utterly lacking in charm; since all noble women in the Tianshu Kingdom valued plumpness as beauty, she was completely unworthy of the General.

Before long, the General's Mansion would likely take in several concubines and maidservants. For a time, unmarried women from various noble families grew restless with ambition.

The eunuch had acted purely out of selfish motives, never imagining that this affair would help Ye Li and Mo Chen evade the Emperor's probing test.

Upon hearing the report, Emperor Xuanyuan Ming waved a hand and said gloatingly, "In that case, there is no need for him to enter the palace."

As it happened, the State Father was in the palace to make a report. Hearing of this, he said with lingering suspicion, "Your Majesty, the Great General rarely misses an audience due to illness. Could it be..."

The eunuch eagerly poured oil on the fire: "Oh, Lord State Father, you simply don't know! Wasn't the General ambushed and assassinated right on the streets of the capital earlier? That wound never really healed properly. Today, when he was carrying his wife, he was covered in blood, oh, that sight..."

The eunuch vividly brainwashed the State Father, who seemed to connect the dots to something and dropped the inquiry altogether.

The matter was thus put to rest.

On the other side, at the imperial-bestowed residence.

Normally, when Mo Chen married, Ye Li should have gone to live at the General's Mansion. However, because the Emperor bestowed this residence, the two of them performed the wedding ceremonies here and were temporarily staying here.

Mo Chen had been taking care of Ye Li all along, pouring tea, serving water, and asking after her well-being.

Seeing him so nervous that sweat beaded on his forehead, Ye Li felt both touched and guilty. She hurriedly mouthed to him:

"I'm not actually sick, I was just tricking him."

Mo Chen stared with wide eyes, his mouth agape in such shock he could have stuffed a large goose egg into it...

His endearingly foolish and dazed look was truly amusing...

Finding Mo Chen like this rather funny, Ye Li let out a soft laugh.

Seeing Ye Li begin to smile, Mo Chen relaxed as well, but he remained deeply curious:

"Wife, why did you want to trick him? If you didn't want to enter the palace, couldn't you have just said so?"

Faced with the serial questioning of the curious baby Mo Chen, Ye Li had no choice but to explain:

"Entering the palace would be very dangerous, so we'll go a bit later."

"If entering the palace is dangerous, then we won't go ever again, or you can just let me go alone while you pretend to be sick at home."

Hearing her reluctance, Mo Chen immediately offered to shield her from all hardships.

At that moment, Ye Li felt as though her heart had been brushed by a feather, sending ripples spreading across a quiet lake.

She increasingly felt that spending time with a Mo Chen like this always made her feel the warmth of being cherished.

For the first time, she took the initiative to hold Mo Chen's hand, mouthing to him:

"Let's enter the palace together in the future. In the end, we still have to face it."

The little cat Annie had not appeared or made trouble in front of outsiders today, but at this moment, quietly lingering at the foot of the bed, it chimed in:

"I shouldn't be here; I should be under the bed..."

Ye Li thought to herself, "Help me follow that eunuch, see what he does, and I'll give you fish when you get back."

Upon hearing this, the little cat Annie cheered loudly, "Small matter, consider it done!"

The cat scampered off in a hurry. Seeing it leave, Mo Chen smiled with the triumphant air of someone who had outlasted the competition.

Looking at Mo Chen, Ye Li half-fancied in a daze that he had grown a large tail and was wagging it defiantly...

The General's contrasting cuteness was actually quite...

Endearing.

Though the thought of potentially facing all sorts of scheming in the palace gave her a twinge of worry, Mo Chen had saved her, and she could not just sit by and watch him fall into crisis.

Today's farce was pure luck; she had managed to get dirt on that eunuch, and the little cat Annie seemed quite formidable in this era, everyone called her the Golden-Threaded Tiger.

Judging by the eunuch's terror today, he likely did not know that Mo Chen had lost his memory.

As long as he wanted to save his own skin, he would have to buy time and delay Mo Chen's entry into the palace; otherwise, the Emperor would punish him for the crime of lese-majeste.

Ye Li sighed and said, "Let's wait a bit longer."

Seeing the sudden sorrow on his wife's face, Mo Chen felt ill at ease, unable to comprehend why she had grown so sad.

Following pure instinct, he gently pulled Ye Li into his embrace. This time, he didn't just circle his arms without daring to touch; instead, his hands firmly met her shoulders, drawing her entire body into his arms as he said guiltily:

"Wife, whenever you're sad, I feel so distressed. Did I do something wrong? Tell me, and I can change."

Mo Chen said in a low voice:

"If you don't like me touching you outside, I won't ever touch you outside again. I'll only hug you inside our room where no one else can see. Is that alright?"

Hearing this reminded Ye Li that he had indeed been very well-behaved outside today.

Be that as it may, in a male-dominated ancient society, the only person currently taking such meticulous care of her and shielding her was Mo Chen. Since they were already married anyway, falling in love after marriage wasn't too hard to accept.

Listening to his heartbeat, Ye Li nodded gently.

At this embracing angle, Mo Chen could not see her lips, so she unfolded his palm and wrote on it:

"Thank you."

"What is my wife thanking me for?"

"You behaved very well today. You even knew how to look after my feelings."

"My wife thinks I did well today?"

Ye Li smiled and made an "mm-hmm" sound.

Immediately afterward, she felt Mo Chen's chest vibrate with happiness. He parted his lips to reveal his standard, bright grin:

"If my wife thinks I did well today, I'll be like this every day to keep my wife happy!"

Then, his large hand naturally began to stroke from her shoulder all the way down to her waist, occasionally sniffing and kissing her hair.

Ye Li was filled with question marks???

Why is he starting again?

So, she pressed down on his hand and asked, "What's wrong with you?"

Mo Chen tilted his head in confusion and asked, "Doesn't my wife like me hugging you?"

"When did I ever say I like you hugging me???"

"You said I performed very well today."

"But what you're doing right now belongs to last night's business, not today's."

"Doesn't a new day only start after sleeping? I haven't slept since last night."

Ye Li: ………………

Is it still not too late to call the eunuch back?

Mo Chen's logic was so flawed that even an elementary school student would cry out in absurdity.

Ye Li had no choice but to comfort herself: the man before her had lost his memory precisely because he saved her. Don't get angry, don't get angry.

She grabbed Mo Chen's wandering hands, pressed them tightly onto her lap, and wrote on his palm:

"I came here and have only seen you. Where is your family?"

She hadn't even served tea to her parents-in-law yet...

She wondered if such a gentle General's father and mother would be easy to get along with.
